20	    - `Narrative_<LineNumber>`
21	    - `Price_<LineNumber>` (optional)
22	    - `Discount_<LineNumber>`
23	    - `Gross` (flag)
24	    - `<LineNumber><TaxKey>_TaxRate`
25	    - `FreightTaxRate<TaxCalculationOrder>`
26	- Session:
27	  - `$_SESSION['CreditItems'.$identifier]` is a Cart object with these properties: DebtorNo, Branch, CustomerName, DefaultSalesType, DefaultCurrency, CurrDecimalPlaces, CurrencyRate, DeliverTo, BrAdd1-6, PhoneNo, Email, SalesPerson, Location, TaxGroup, DispatchTaxProvince, LineItems, LineCounter, FreightCost, FreightTaxes, total, totalVolume, totalWeight, ItemsOrdered, CreditType.
28	  - Other session keys: `RequireCustomerSelection`, `FormID`, `CompanyRecord['gllink_stock'|'gllink_debtors'|'debtorsact'|'freightact']`, `CurrencyRate`, `SO_AllowSameItemMultipleTimes`, `QuickEntries`, `part_pics_dir`, `SalesmanLogin`, `UserID`, `InvoicePortraitFormat`, `DefaultDateFormat`.
29	- The menu entry is `/SelectCreditItems.php?NewCredit=Yes` ("Create A Credit Note", AR Transactions, seq 2). It is defined in `webERP/install/sql/data/menuitems.sql`.
30	- `webERP/Credit_Invoice.php` initialises a credit note from an invoice into the same kind of session cart. It is a different path. Its condensation was not read.
31	
32	**Out of SelectCreditItems.php**
33	- Reads: custbranch, debtorsmaster, currencies, locations, stockmaster, stockcategory, locstock, bom, chartmaster joined with accountgroups, salesman, locationusers.
34	- Writes:
35	  - debtortrans, debtortranstaxes
36	  - stockmoves, stockmovestaxes
37	  - stockserialitems, stockserialmoves
38	  - locstock
39	  - salesanalysis
40	  - gltrans
41	- Credit note posting values:
42	  - debtortrans: `type='11'`, all amounts negated (ovamount, ovgst, ovfreight, tax), `prd` from GetPeriod, `tpe` from DefaultSalesType, `inputdate` now. The id comes from `DB_Last_Insert_ID('debtortrans','id')`.
43	  - Transaction number from `GetNextTransNo(11)`.
44	  - debtortranstaxes: one row per `$TaxTotals` tax authority.
45	  - stockmoves: `type=11`.
46	  - stockmoves for `ReverseOverCharge`: `hidemovt=1`, `newqoh = QtyOnHandPrior`.
47	  - Return or write-off with MBflag 'M' or 'B': `newqoh = QtyOnHandPrior + Quantity`.
48	  - Return or write-off with any other MBflag: `newqoh` is omitted from the INSERT.
49	  - stockmovestaxes: one row per tax of the line.
50	  - Serial lines: stockserialitems is inserted (`$MyRow[0]==0`) or updated (`quantity=quantity+BundleQty`), then stockserialmoves is inserted.
51	- Link to CreditItemsControlled.php: `CreditItemsControlled.php?LineNo=<n>&identifier=<id>`.
52	
53	**Z_DeleteCreditNote.php**
54	- In: GET `CreditNoteNo` (no format validation).
55	- Reads: debtortrans (`order_`, `id`), stockmoves (`stockid`, `loccode`, `debtorno`, `branchcode`, `prd`, `qty`), and information_schema.
56	- Deletes and updates:
57	  - custallocns, debtortranstaxes, debtortrans
58	  - salesorderdetails (`qtyinvoiced` updated)
59	  - locstock (quantity updated)
60	  - salesanalysis, stockmovestaxes, stockserialmoves, stockmoves
61	  - gltrans (`type=11 AND typeno=CreditNoteNo`)
62	
63	## Entry points
64	**SelectCreditItems.php** (checks in the order they run)
65	1. `if empty($_GET['identifier'])` -> `$identifier = date('U')`; else it is taken from GET.
66	2. `if isset($_POST['ProcessCredit']) AND !isset($_SESSION['CreditItems'.$identifier])` -> message "This credit note has already been processed", exit.
67	3. `if isset($_GET['NewCredit'])` -> unset the existing CreditItems session and start a new Cart.
68	4. `if !isset($_SESSION['CreditItems'.$identifier])` -> new Cart, `RequireCustomerSelection = 1`.
69	5. `if isset($_POST['ChangeCustomer'])` -> `RequireCustomerSelection = 1`.
70	6. `if isset($_POST['CancelCredit'])` -> unset the session, new Cart, `RequireCustomerSelection = 1`.
71	7. `if isset($_POST['SearchCust']) AND RequireCustomerSelection == 1` -> run the customer search.
72	8. `if isset($_POST['SalesPerson'])` -> set Cart SalesPerson.
73	9. `if isset($_POST['Search'])` -> stock search.
74	10. `if isset($_POST['QuickEntry'])` -> quick-entry processing.
75	11. `if isset($_POST['Delete'])` -> `remove_from_cart`.
76	12. `isset($_POST['ChargeFreightCost'])` -> set FreightCost; `Location` change; per-line updates; freight tax updates; `NewItem` add.
77	13. The items form is displayed `if ItemsOrdered > 0 OR isset($_POST['NewItem'])`.
78	14. `ProcessCredit` is shown only `if !isset($_POST['ProcessCredit']) AND $OKToProcess == true`.
79	15. Posting begins when `isset($_POST['ProcessCredit']) AND $OKToProcess==true`.
80	16. No permission check is shown anywhere in the screen.
81	
82	**Z_DeleteCreditNote.php**
83	- `if !isset($_GET['CreditNoteNo'])` -> message that the parameter is required. The condensation does not say whether the script stops there.
84	- No authorization or confirmation check is shown. It is marked for manual use by administrators.
85	
86	## Decisions
87	**Customer search**
88	- Keywords and CustCode both set -> message that keywords take preference.
89	- Both empty -> message "At least one Customer Name keyword OR an extract of a Customer Code must be entered for the search".
90	- `mb_strlen(Keywords) > 0` -> `custbranch.brname LIKE '%kw%'` (spaces become %) `AND custbranch.disabletrans = '0'`. Else if CustCode is non-empty -> `custbranch.debtorno LIKE '%code%' AND disabletrans='0'`. Branches with `disabletrans` other than '0' are never listed.
91	- Result rows == 1 -> that customer is selected and `JustSelectedACustomer = true`. Rows == 0 -> "Sorry ... there are no customer branch records…".
92	- `JustSelectedACustomer` set without `$SelectedCustomer` -> loop over `SubmitCustomerSelection<i>`. If none is found -> error "Unable to identify the selected customer".
93	- Customer chosen -> set DebtorNo, Branch, `RequireCustomerSelection=0`. Load the customer details with an INNER JOIN of custbranch, locations, debtorsmaster and currencies, so a branch with no default location or currency is not loaded. Then call `GetFreightTaxes()`.
94	- The customer form is shown if `RequireCustomerSelection==1 OR DebtorNo unset OR DebtorNo==''`. The table prints the customer name only when `$LastCustomer != name`.
95	
96	**Stock search**
97	- Keywords and StockCode both non-empty -> a message says keywords take precedence.
98	- Keywords non-empty -> `stockmaster.description LIKE` (spaces become %).
99	- Else StockCode non-empty -> `stockmaster.stockid LIKE %code%`.
100	- Else no text filter. `StockCat=='All'` adds no category filter; otherwise `categoryid='...'`.
101	- The search query is restricted to `stockcategory.stocktype='F' OR 'D'`.
102	- 0 rows -> info message. 1 row -> `NewItem` is set to that stockid.
103	
104	**Quick entry**
105	- Loop i=1..QuickEntries. The inner do-while skips a row while `!is_numeric(filter_number_format(qty)) AND qty<=0 AND strlen(part)!=0`. Because the three tests are joined with AND, it behaves oddly. Examples: a non-numeric quantity such as text normally filters to 0, which satisfies `<=0` and so is skipped, but a non-empty `part` with a positive numeric quantity is taken.
106	- `NewItem = trim(part)`, `NewItemQty = filter_number_format(qty)`. `strlen(NewItem)==0` -> break.
107	
108	**Adding an item**
109	- `SO_AllowSameItemMultipleTimes==0 AND strcasecmp(StockID, NewItem)==0` for any line -> `AlreadyOnThisCredit=1` and a warning. The item is not added.
110	- Otherwise select from stockmaster. On a hit, call `add_to_cart(...)` with price from `GetPrice(NewItem, DebtorNo, Branch)`. On a miss -> warning that the item does not exist.
111	- In the edit path, `add_to_cart` is called with quantity 1 and discount 0. The quick-entry path passes a different argument list (`-1`, 'No', taxcatid).
112	- `add_to_cart` returns 1 -> `GetTaxes(LineNumber)`. `controlled==1` -> `Quantity=0` (the user enters serials on `CreditItemsControlled.php`).
113	
114	**Editing lines**
115	- `POST Location != current` -> select `taxprovinceid FROM locations WHERE loccode='<Location>'`, set DispatchTaxProvince, and call `GetTaxes` on every line.
116	- `Price_<n>` set and `Gross==true` -> `price = price / (TaxTotalPercent+1)`. TaxTotalPercent adds `(1+prior)*TaxRate` where `TaxOnTax==1`, else `TaxRate`.
117	- Tax rate input applies only if `is_numeric(...)`: `TaxRate = value/100`.
118	- `Quantity<0 OR Price<0 OR DiscountPercentage>100 OR DiscountPercentage<0` -> warning, no update. Otherwise `update_cart_item(LineNumber, Quantity, Price, Discount/100, Narrative, 'No', ItemDue, POLine, 0, identifier)`.
119	- Display:
120	  - `LineTotal = round(Quantity*Price*(1-DiscountPercent), CurrDecimalPlaces)`.
121	  - `Controlled==0` -> editable quantity box. `Controlled==1` -> link to CreditItemsControlled.php plus a hidden `Quantity_<n>`.
122	  - Tax on a line: `TaxOnTax==1` -> `TaxRate*(LineTotal+TaxLineTotal)`, else `TaxRate*LineTotal`. Freight tax uses the same rule on `FreightCost`.
123	  - `!isset(POST ChargeFreightCost) AND !isset(FreightCost)` -> `ChargeFreightCost=0`.
124	  - The CreditType selector lists Return first when `CreditType` is unset or 'Return', and otherwise puts the chosen type first.
125	
126	**Form fields by CreditType**
127	- CreditType unset or 'Return' -> Location select. It lists locations INNER JOIN locationusers `WHERE userid=$_SESSION['UserID'] AND canupd=1`.
128	- CreditType 'WriteOff' -> WriteOffGLCode select (chartmaster INNER JOIN accountgroups `pandl=1`). `ReverseOverCharge` shows neither select.
129	- SalesPerson select covers `salesman WHERE current=1`. `!isset(POST SalesPerson) AND SalesmanLogin!=NULL` -> Cart SalesPerson = `SalesmanLogin`.
130	- `CreditType=='WriteOff' AND !isset(WriteOffGLCode)` -> info message and `OKToProcess=false`, so the ProcessCredit button is not shown.
131	- Search form is shown `if isset(PartSearch) AND PartSearch!='' AND !isset(ProcessCredit)`. Otherwise, if `!isset(ProcessCredit)`, the quick-entry form is shown.
132	
133	**Posting**
134	- `gllink_stock==1 AND CreditType=='WriteOff' AND (!isset(WriteOffGLCode) OR ==''` -> error, footer, exit before any DB writes.
135	- Lines are processed only `if $CreditLine->Quantity > 0`. Lines with quantity 0 (including controlled lines with no serials entered) or negative are dropped.
136	- Stock side (`StockMoves`):
137	  - `CreditType=='ReverseOverCharge'` -> stockmoves with `hidemovt=1` only. There is no locstock change and no taxes or serials.
138	  - `MBflag in ('M','B')` -> read `locstock.quantity` for `QtyOnHandPrior`; one row -> use it, else 0. Other MBflag -> 0.
139	  - Return with `MBflag 'B' OR 'M'` -> `locstock.quantity += Quantity`.
140	  - Return with `MBflag 'A'` -> read the BOM components valid at today's date (`effectiveafter <= CURRENT_DATE AND effectiveto > CURRENT_DATE`). For each component: stockmoves (`reference "Assembly: <StockID>"`, `qty = component qty * line qty`, `show_on_inv_crds=0`, `newqoh = prior + qty`) and `locstock` increase. The line `StandardCost` is replaced by the sum of component standard costs. This replaced cost is used by the later GL posting.
141	  - WriteOff with 'B' or 'M' -> stockmoves `type 11`, `qty = -Quantity`, `newqoh = QtyOnHandPrior`. WriteOff with 'A' -> same without `newqoh`.
142	  - `Controlled==1 AND MBflag in ('M','B')` -> loop `SerialItems`.
143	  - Return: SELECT COUNT from stockserialitems. Zero -> INSERT, else `quantity+BundleQty`. Then insert stockserialmoves.
144	  - WriteOff: `stockserialitems.quantity -= BundleQty` and stockserialmoves `moveqty -BundleQty`.
145	  - `SalesValue = Price*Quantity/CurrencyRate` if `CurrencyRate>0`, else 0.
146	- Sales analysis. SELECT count where stockid, salesperson, typeabbrev, periodno, debtorno, branchcode, area and `budgetoractual=1` match:
147	  - Row exists and `ReverseOverCharge` -> `amt=amt-SalesValue`, `disc=disc-(DiscountPercent*SalesValue)`.
148	  - Row exists and not `ReverseOverCharge` -> Amt, Cost, Qty, Disc are all decremented.
149	  - No row and `ReverseOverCharge` -> INSERT with negative value and discount, zero qty.
150	  - No row and not `ReverseOverCharge` -> INSERT with negative value, cost, qty and discount.
151	- Stock GL (COGS and stock):
152	  - `gllink_stock==1 AND StandardCost!=0 AND CreditType!='ReverseOverCharge'` -> `GetCOGSGLAccount(Area, StockID, DefaultSalesType)`. gltrans type 11 at `-(StandardCost*Quantity)` on the COGS account.
153	  - `CreditType=='WriteOff'` -> gltrans on `WriteOffGLCode` at `+StandardCost*Quantity`.
154	  - `CreditType!='WriteOff'` (goods return, which includes ReverseOverCharge) -> `GetStockGLCode(StockID)`, gltrans on `stockact` at `+StandardCost*Quantity`.
155	  - The COGS credit and the stock or write-off debit are both inside the `gllink_stock==1` branch in the condensation. The write-off and stock-return inserts as described are not shown as separately guarded, so for `ReverseOverCharge` the stock-account debit can be posted without the COGS credit. A reader should check the source to confirm.
156	- Sales GL:
157	  - `gllink_debtors==1 AND Price!=0` -> `GetSalesGLAccount(Area, StockID, DefaultSalesType)` returns `salesglcode` and `discountglcode`. gltrans type 11 is inserted for the sale.
158	  - `DiscountPercent!=0` -> a second discount gltrans at a negative amount. Narratives are truncated to 200 characters.
159	- Header GL (`gllink_debtors==1`):
160	  - `(total + FreightCost + TaxTotal) != 0` -> `debtorsact` at `-(total+freight+tax)/CurrencyRate`.
161	  - `FreightCost != 0` -> `freightact` at `FreightCost/CurrencyRate`.
162	  - Each `TaxTotals[TaxAuthID] != 0` -> `TaxGLCodes[TaxAuthID]` at `amount/CurrencyRate`.
163	  - Then `EnsureGLEntriesBalance(11, CreditNo)`, `DB_Txn_Commit()`, unset LineItems and the CreditItems session, and show confirmation with print and re-entry links.
164	
165	**Z_DeleteCreditNote.php**
166	- Looks up debtortrans `transno=CreditNoteNo AND type='11'`. Stockmovements are looked up by `type='11'`.
167	- Inside `DB_Txn_Begin` ... `DB_Txn_Commit`, it deletes in this order: custallocns, debtortranstaxes, debtortrans. It then loops each stockmove and updates `salesorderdetails.qtyinvoiced` and `locstock`. Next it deletes salesanalysis, stockmovestaxes, stockserialmoves, stockmoves, and finally gltrans.
168	- The user is told to repost GL from the credit note's period.
169	
170	## Order and failure
171	- `DB_Txn_Begin()` is called in posting. Then come `GetNextTransNo(11)`, `GetPeriod()`, the debtortrans INSERT (id from `DB_Last_Insert_ID`), debtortranstaxes, and the per-line stock, analysis and GL inserts. The header GL entries, `EnsureGLEntriesBalance` and `DB_Txn_Commit` come last. The session is cleared only after commit.
172	- Every posting `DB_query` carries a "CRITICAL ERROR! NOTE DOWN THIS ERROR AND SEEK ASSISTANCE: …" message and `true` as the fourth parameter. The meaning of `true` is not shown in the condensation. No custom handler or rollback is shown. Stock and serial inserts use `DB_Last_Insert_ID('stockmoves','stkmoveno')` with no check of the value.
173	- Before posting, the only early exits are the WriteOff-without-GL-code exit and the "already processed" exit.
174	- `GetPrice`, `GetTaxes`, `GetImageLink` and `glob` have no error handling.
175	- Z_DeleteCreditNote: every query passes `ErrMsg` and `true`. A failure leaves the uncommitted transaction. No existence check is shown.
176	
177	## Connections
178	- `webERP/CreditItemsControlled.php`:
179	  - Reached by link from controlled lines, with `identifier` and `LineNo`.
180	  - Guards:
181	    - Missing `identifier` -> error and exit.
182	    - Missing `LineNo` (GET or POST) -> error and exit.
183	    - No session cart `CreditItems<id>` -> error and exit.
184	    - Line `Controlled != 1` -> warning and exit.
185	  - Includes `includes/InputSerialItems.php` with `LocationOut = Cart Location`, `ItemMustExist = SESSION['CreditingControlledItems_MustExist']`, `StockID`, `InOutModifier=1`, `ShowExisting=false`, `IsCredit=true`.
186	  - Delete: GET `Delete` unsets that serial item. The total then goes to `LineItems[LineNo]->QtyDispatched` when `CreditLink=='Credit_Invoice.php?identifier=<id>'`, else to `Quantity`.
187	- `webERP/Credit_Invoice.php`: the other path that fills `CreditItems<id>` (from an invoice). Detail not read.
188	- Helper functions whose behaviour is outside this topic: `GetPrice`, `GetNextTransNo(11)`, `GetPeriod`, `GetCOGSGLAccount`, `GetStockGLCode`, `GetSalesGLAccount`, `EnsureGLEntriesBalance`, `DB_Txn_*`, and the Cart methods (`add_to_cart`, `update_cart_item`, `remove_from_cart`, `GetTaxes`, `GetFreightTaxes`). The Cart class file was not found by name.
189	- `webERP/install/sql/data/scripts.sql` lists Z_DeleteCreditNote.php as a script. It has no menu entry in the files read.
190	
191	## Conclusions
192	- Lines with `Quantity <= 0` are dropped from posting. A controlled line starts at Quantity 0 and is dropped unless serials are entered, so it posts only after serial entry.
193	- `ReverseOverCharge` changes no stock quantity. It writes a hidden stock move and a sales analysis reduction of amount and discount only. It skips the COGS credit, but see the note above on the stock-account debit.
194	- The location list is limited to locations with `canupd=1` for the user. The POSTed `Location` is later used without re-checking that permission.
195	- The posting path has no duplicate guard beyond the session being unset. A repeat POST gets "already processed" only because the session key is gone. With a reused `identifier` from a second tab, a second credit can be processed.
196	- `Z_DeleteCreditNote` removes salesanalysis rows. The source marks this "unreliable" because rows hold totals. It also zeroes nothing that the original posting left in `Credit_Invoice` links.
197	- Z_DeleteCreditNote reverses locstock with the stored move quantity and reverses `salesorderdetails.qtyinvoiced`. It does not undo bank or other GL outside type 11.
198	- All user input goes straight into SQL (`NewItem`, `Location`, `CreditNoteNo`) without escaping. This is a SQL-injection risk.
199	- The `DB_query` fourth parameter `true` and the lack of an explicit rollback mean a failure mid-posting leaves partial data unless `DB_query` aborts and rolls back (behaviour not in this topic).
200	
201	## Hazards
202	- Currency rate division with no zero check in the header GL (`/CurrencyRate`). The line SalesValue guards `>0`.
203	- Serial and tax inserts rely on an unchecked `StkMoveNo`.
204	- Serial `BundleRef` and `WriteOffGLCode` are not validated against any table.
205	- Nothing is shown that restricts who can run Z_DeleteCreditNote.php, and there is no `CreditNoteNo` existence check.
206	- Z_DeleteCreditNote: a missing credit note number leads to an empty-arguments deletion. If the script does not stop after the "required parameter" message, the later deletes run with an empty number.
207	
208	## Open first
209	- `webERP/SelectCreditItems.php`: the whole credit entry and posting flow.
210	- `webERP/CreditItemsControlled.php`: serial entry for controlled lines.
211	- `webERP/Z_DeleteCreditNote.php`: reversal utility.
212	
213	## Connected topics
214	
215	Topics this one exchanges work or records with, wherever they sit in the map (paths from the export's root):
216	
217	- [webERP controlled-item serial/batch entry pages, picking-list processing and…](weberp-sales-purchasing-stock-manufacturing-master-data-repo-151/weberp-controlled-item-serial-batch-entry-pages-picking-list-82/brief.md)
218	  - this topic took from `webERP/CreditItemsControlled.php`: guards, `InputSerialItems` include parameters, and the Delete handling (QtyDispatched or Quantity).
219	- [webERP install seed data: menu items, module list and transaction types](weberp-installer-seed-data-schema-build-ci-and-project-histo-150/weberp-install-seed-data-menu-items-module-list-and-transact-10/brief.md)
220	  - this topic took from `webERP/install/sql/data/menuitems.sql`: the menu entry "Create A Credit Note" (`/SelectCreditItems.php?NewCredit=Yes`, AR Transactions, seq 2).
221	- [webERP install seed data: config, currencies, product-spec groups, script…](weberp-installer-seed-data-schema-build-ci-and-project-histo-150/weberp-install-seed-data-config-currencies-product-spec-grou-9/brief.md)
222	  - this topic took from `webERP/install/sql/data/scripts.sql`: Z_DeleteCreditNote.php is listed as a script.
223	- [webERP customer transaction print and email (EmailCustTrans.php…](weberp-sales-purchasing-stock-manufacturing-master-data-repo-151/weberp-customer-transaction-print-and-email-emailcusttrans-p-60/brief.md)
224	  - it took from this topic's `webERP/SelectCreditItems.php`: sends credit-note links with and without `PrintPDF`.

# webERP credit notes: entry screen, posting, and delete utility (SelectCreditItems.php, Z_DeleteCreditNote.php)

Part of [webERP: sales, purchasing, stock, manufacturing, master data, reporting, API…](weberp-sales-purchasing-stock-manufacturing-master-data-repo-151/brief.md) (path from the export's root): its brief says how work moves through the area and what repairs a failed step.

`webERP/SelectCreditItems.php` builds a manual credit note in the session. It selects the customer, adds stock lines, edits prices, quantities, discounts, taxes and freight, and on `ProcessCredit` posts the credit note as transaction type 11. `webERP/Z_DeleteCreditNote.php` is a separate admin utility that reverses a posted type 11 credit note. The posting code writes to debtortrans and the stock, analysis and GL tables. Controlled (serial) lines are handed to `webERP/CreditItemsControlled.php`.

## Contract
**Into SelectCreditItems.php**
- GET:
  - `identifier`: session key suffix. If empty, `$identifier = date('U')`.
  - `NewCredit`.
- POST:
  - Buttons and actions: `ProcessCredit`, `ChangeCustomer`, `CancelCredit`, `Quick`, `NewCredit`, `SearchCust`, `JustSelectedACustomer`, `Search`, `QuickEntry`, `PartSearch`, `Delete`.
  - Customer search: `Keywords`, `CustCode`; selection through `SubmitCustomerSelection<i>`, `SelectedCustomer<i>`, `SelectedBranch<i>`.
  - Item search: `StockCat` ('All' or a category id), `StockCode`, `NewItem`.
  - Quick entry: `part_N`, `qty_N`, for N = 1..`$_SESSION['QuickEntries']`.
  - Header fields: `SalesPerson`, `Location`, `ChargeFreightCost`, `CreditType` (`Return`, `WriteOff`, `ReverseOverCharge`), `WriteOffGLCode`, `CreditText`.
  - Per line:
    - `Quantity_<LineNumber>`
    - `Narrative_<LineNumber>`
    - `Price_<LineNumber>` (optional)
    - `Discount_<LineNumber>`
    - `Gross` (flag)
    - `<LineNumber><TaxKey>_TaxRate`
    - `FreightTaxRate<TaxCalculationOrder>`
- Session:
  - `$_SESSION['CreditItems'.$identifier]` is a Cart object with these properties: DebtorNo, Branch, CustomerName, DefaultSalesType, DefaultCurrency, CurrDecimalPlaces, CurrencyRate, DeliverTo, BrAdd1-6, PhoneNo, Email, SalesPerson, Location, TaxGroup, DispatchTaxProvince, LineItems, LineCounter, FreightCost, FreightTaxes, total, totalVolume, totalWeight, ItemsOrdered, CreditType.
  - Other session keys: `RequireCustomerSelection`, `FormID`, `CompanyRecord['gllink_stock'|'gllink_debtors'|'debtorsact'|'freightact']`, `CurrencyRate`, `SO_AllowSameItemMultipleTimes`, `QuickEntries`, `part_pics_dir`, `SalesmanLogin`, `UserID`, `InvoicePortraitFormat`, `DefaultDateFormat`.
- The menu entry is `/SelectCreditItems.php?NewCredit=Yes` ("Create A Credit Note", AR Transactions, seq 2). It is defined in `webERP/install/sql/data/menuitems.sql`.
- `webERP/Credit_Invoice.php` initialises a credit note from an invoice into the same kind of session cart. It is a different path. Its condensation was not read.

**Out of SelectCreditItems.php**
- Reads: custbranch, debtorsmaster, currencies, locations, stockmaster, stockcategory, locstock, bom, chartmaster joined with accountgroups, salesman, locationusers.
- Writes:
  - debtortrans, debtortranstaxes
  - stockmoves, stockmovestaxes
  - stockserialitems, stockserialmoves
  - locstock
  - salesanalysis
  - gltrans
- Credit note posting values:
  - debtortrans: `type='11'`, all amounts negated (ovamount, ovgst, ovfreight, tax), `prd` from GetPeriod, `tpe` from DefaultSalesType, `inputdate` now. The id comes from `DB_Last_Insert_ID('debtortrans','id')`.
  - Transaction number from `GetNextTransNo(11)`.
  - debtortranstaxes: one row per `$TaxTotals` tax authority.
  - stockmoves: `type=11`.
  - stockmoves for `ReverseOverCharge`: `hidemovt=1`, `newqoh = QtyOnHandPrior`.
  - Return or write-off with MBflag 'M' or 'B': `newqoh = QtyOnHandPrior + Quantity`.
  - Return or write-off with any other MBflag: `newqoh` is omitted from the INSERT.
  - stockmovestaxes: one row per tax of the line.
  - Serial lines: stockserialitems is inserted (`$MyRow[0]==0`) or updated (`quantity=quantity+BundleQty`), then stockserialmoves is inserted.
- Link to CreditItemsControlled.php: `CreditItemsControlled.php?LineNo=<n>&identifier=<id>`.

**Z_DeleteCreditNote.php**
- In: GET `CreditNoteNo` (no format validation).
- Reads: debtortrans (`order_`, `id`), stockmoves (`stockid`, `loccode`, `debtorno`, `branchcode`, `prd`, `qty`), and information_schema.
- Deletes and updates:
  - custallocns, debtortranstaxes, debtortrans
  - salesorderdetails (`qtyinvoiced` updated)
  - locstock (quantity updated)
  - salesanalysis, stockmovestaxes, stockserialmoves, stockmoves
  - gltrans (`type=11 AND typeno=CreditNoteNo`)

## Entry points
**SelectCreditItems.php** (checks in the order they run)
1. `if empty($_GET['identifier'])` -> `$identifier = date('U')`; else it is taken from GET.

## Decisions
**Customer search**
- Keywords and CustCode both set -> message that keywords take preference.
- Both empty -> message "At least one Customer Name keyword OR an extract of a Customer Code must be entered for the search".
- `mb_strlen(Keywords) > 0` -> `custbranch.brname LIKE '%kw%'` (spaces become %) `AND custbranch.disabletrans = '0'`. Else if CustCode is non-empty -> `custbranch.debtorno LIKE '%code%' AND disabletrans='0'`. Branches with `disabletrans` other than '0' are never listed.
- Result rows == 1 -> that customer is selected and `JustSelectedACustomer = true`. Rows == 0 -> "Sorry ... there are no customer branch records…".
- `JustSelectedACustomer` set without `$SelectedCustomer` -> loop over `SubmitCustomerSelection<i>`. If none is found -> error "Unable to identify the selected customer".
- Customer chosen -> set DebtorNo, Branch, `RequireCustomerSelection=0`. Load the customer details with an INNER JOIN of custbranch, locations, debtorsmaster and currencies, so a branch with no default location or currency is not loaded. Then call `GetFreightTaxes()`.
- The customer form is shown if `RequireCustomerSelection==1 OR DebtorNo unset OR DebtorNo==''`. The table prints the customer name only when `$LastCustomer != name`.

**Stock search**
- Keywords and StockCode both non-empty -> a message says keywords take precedence.
- Keywords non-empty -> `stockmaster.description LIKE` (spaces become %).
- Else StockCode non-empty -> `stockmaster.stockid LIKE %code%`.
- Else no text filter. `StockCat=='All'` adds no category filter; otherwise `categoryid='...'`.
- The search query is restricted to `stockcategory.stocktype='F' OR 'D'`.
- 0 rows -> info message. 1 row -> `NewItem` is set to that stockid.

**Quick entry**
- Loop i=1..QuickEntries. The inner do-while skips a row while `!is_numeric(filter_number_format(qty)) AND qty<=0 AND strlen(part)!=0`. Because the three tests are joined with AND, it behaves oddly. Examples: a non-numeric quantity such as text normally filters to 0, which satisfies `<=0` and so is skipped, but a non-empty `part` with a positive numeric quantity is taken.
- `NewItem = trim(part)`, `NewItemQty = filter_number_format(qty)`. `strlen(NewItem)==0` -> break.

**Adding an item**
- `SO_AllowSameItemMultipleTimes==0 AND strcasecmp(StockID, NewItem)==0` for any line -> `AlreadyOnThisCredit=1` and a warning. The item is not added.
- Otherwise select from stockmaster. On a hit, call `add_to_cart(...)` with price from `GetPrice(NewItem, DebtorNo, Branch)`. On a miss -> warning that the item does not exist.
- In the edit path, `add_to_cart` is called with quantity 1 and discount 0. The quick-entry path passes a different argument list (`-1`, 'No', taxcatid).
- `add_to_cart` returns 1 -> `GetTaxes(LineNumber)`. `controlled==1` -> `Quantity=0` (the user enters serials on `CreditItemsControlled.php`).

**Editing lines**
- `POST Location != current` -> select `taxprovinceid FROM locations WHERE loccode='<Location>'`, set DispatchTaxProvince, and call `GetTaxes` on every line.
- `Price_<n>` set and `Gross==true` -> `price = price / (TaxTotalPercent+1)`. TaxTotalPercent adds `(1+prior)*TaxRate` where `TaxOnTax==1`, else `TaxRate`.
- Tax rate input applies only if `is_numeric(...)`: `TaxRate = value/100`.
- `Quantity<0 OR Price<0 OR DiscountPercentage>100 OR DiscountPercentage<0` -> warning, no update. Otherwise `update_cart_item(LineNumber, Quantity, Price, Discount/100, Narrative, 'No', ItemDue, POLine, 0, identifier)`.
- Display:
  - `LineTotal = round(Quantity*Price*(1-DiscountPercent), CurrDecimalPlaces)`.
  - `Controlled==0` -> editable quantity box. `Controlled==1` -> link to CreditItemsControlled.php plus a hidden `Quantity_<n>`.
  - Tax on a line: `TaxOnTax==1` -> `TaxRate*(LineTotal+TaxLineTotal)`, else `TaxRate*LineTotal`. Freight tax uses the same rule on `FreightCost`.
  - `!isset(POST ChargeFreightCost) AND !isset(FreightCost)` -> `ChargeFreightCost=0`.
  - The CreditType selector lists Return first when `CreditType` is unset or 'Return', and otherwise puts the chosen type first.

**Form fields by CreditType**
- CreditType unset or 'Return' -> Location select. It lists locations INNER JOIN locationusers `WHERE userid=$_SESSION['UserID'] AND canupd=1`.
- CreditType 'WriteOff' -> WriteOffGLCode select (chartmaster INNER JOIN accountgroups `pandl=1`). `ReverseOverCharge` shows neither select.
- SalesPerson select covers `salesman WHERE current=1`. `!isset(POST SalesPerson) AND SalesmanLogin!=NULL` -> Cart SalesPerson = `SalesmanLogin`.
- `CreditType=='WriteOff' AND !isset(WriteOffGLCode)` -> info message and `OKToProcess=false`, so the ProcessCredit button is not shown.
- Search form is shown `if isset(PartSearch) AND PartSearch!='' AND !isset(ProcessCredit)`. Otherwise, if `!isset(ProcessCredit)`, the quick-entry form is shown.

**Posting**
- `gllink_stock==1 AND CreditType=='WriteOff' AND (!isset(WriteOffGLCode) OR ==''` -> error, footer, exit before any DB writes.
- Lines are processed only `if $CreditLine->Quantity > 0`. Lines with quantity 0 (including controlled lines with no serials entered) or negative are dropped.
- Stock side (`StockMoves`):
  - `CreditType=='ReverseOverCharge'` -> stockmoves with `hidemovt=1` only. There is no locstock change and no taxes or serials.
  - `MBflag in ('M','B')` -> read `locstock.quantity` for `QtyOnHandPrior`; one row -> use it, else 0. Other MBflag -> 0.
  - Return with `MBflag 'B' OR 'M'` -> `locstock.quantity += Quantity`.
  - Return with `MBflag 'A'` -> read the BOM components valid at today's date (`effectiveafter <= CURRENT_DATE AND effectiveto > CURRENT_DATE`). For each component: stockmoves (`reference "Assembly: <StockID>"`, `qty = component qty * line qty`, `show_on_inv_crds=0`, `newqoh = prior + qty`) and `locstock` increase. The line `StandardCost` is replaced by the sum of component standard costs. This replaced cost is used by the later GL posting.
  - WriteOff with 'B' or 'M' -> stockmoves `type 11`, `qty = -Quantity`, `newqoh = QtyOnHandPrior`. WriteOff with 'A' -> same without `newqoh`.
  - `Controlled==1 AND MBflag in ('M','B')` -> loop `SerialItems`.
  - Return: SELECT COUNT from stockserialitems. Zero -> INSERT, else `quantity+BundleQty`. Then insert stockserialmoves.
  - WriteOff: `stockserialitems.quantity -= BundleQty` and stockserialmoves `moveqty -BundleQty`.
  - `SalesValue = Price*Quantity/CurrencyRate` if `CurrencyRate>0`, else 0.
- Sales analysis. SELECT count where stockid, salesperson, typeabbrev, periodno, debtorno, branchcode, area and `budgetoractual=1` match:
  - Row exists and `ReverseOverCharge` -> `amt=amt-SalesValue`, `disc=disc-(DiscountPercent*SalesValue)`.
  - Row exists and not `ReverseOverCharge` -> Amt, Cost, Qty, Disc are all decremented.
  - No row and `ReverseOverCharge` -> INSERT with negative value and discount, zero qty.
  - No row and not `ReverseOverCharge` -> INSERT with negative value, cost, qty and discount.
- Stock GL (COGS and stock):
  - `gllink_stock==1 AND StandardCost!=0 AND CreditType!='ReverseOverCharge'` -> `GetCOGSGLAccount(Area, StockID, DefaultSalesType)`. gltrans type 11 at `-(StandardCost*Quantity)` on the COGS account.
  - `CreditType=='WriteOff'` -> gltrans on `WriteOffGLCode` at `+StandardCost*Quantity`.
  - `CreditType!='WriteOff'` (goods return, which includes ReverseOverCharge) -> `GetStockGLCode(StockID)`, gltrans on `stockact` at `+StandardCost*Quantity`.
  - The COGS credit and the stock or write-off debit are both inside the `gllink_stock==1` branch in the condensation. The write-off and stock-return inserts as described are not shown as separately guarded, so for `ReverseOverCharge` the stock-account debit can be posted without the COGS credit. A reader should check the source to confirm.
- Sales GL:
  - `gllink_debtors==1 AND Price!=0` -> `GetSalesGLAccount(Area, StockID, DefaultSalesType)` returns `salesglcode` and `discountglcode`. gltrans type 11 is inserted for the sale.
  - `DiscountPercent!=0` -> a second discount gltrans at a negative amount. Narratives are truncated to 200 characters.
- Header GL (`gllink_debtors==1`):
  - `(total + FreightCost + TaxTotal) != 0` -> `debtorsact` at `-(total+freight+tax)/CurrencyRate`.
  - `FreightCost != 0` -> `freightact` at `FreightCost/CurrencyRate`.
  - Each `TaxTotals[TaxAuthID] != 0` -> `TaxGLCodes[TaxAuthID]` at `amount/CurrencyRate`.
  - Then `EnsureGLEntriesBalance(11, CreditNo)`, `DB_Txn_Commit()`, unset LineItems and the CreditItems session, and show confirmation with print and re-entry links.

**Z_DeleteCreditNote.php**
- Looks up debtortrans `transno=CreditNoteNo AND type='11'`. Stockmovements are looked up by `type='11'`.
- Inside `DB_Txn_Begin` ... `DB_Txn_Commit`, it deletes in this order: custallocns, debtortranstaxes, debtortrans. It then loops each stockmove and updates `salesorderdetails.qtyinvoiced` and `locstock`. Next it deletes salesanalysis, stockmovestaxes, stockserialmoves, stockmoves, and finally gltrans.
- The user is told to repost GL from the credit note's period.

## Order and failure
- `DB_Txn_Begin()` is called in posting. Then come `GetNextTransNo(11)`, `GetPeriod()`, the debtortrans INSERT (id from `DB_Last_Insert_ID`), debtortranstaxes, and the per-line stock, analysis and GL inserts. The header GL entries, `EnsureGLEntriesBalance` and `DB_Txn_Commit` come last. The session is cleared only after commit.
- Every posting `DB_query` carries a "CRITICAL ERROR! NOTE DOWN THIS ERROR AND SEEK ASSISTANCE: …" message and `true` as the fourth parameter. The meaning of `true` is not shown in the condensation. No custom handler or rollback is shown. Stock and serial inserts use `DB_Last_Insert_ID('stockmoves','stkmoveno')` with no check of the value.
- Before posting, the only early exits are the WriteOff-without-GL-code exit and the "already processed" exit.
- `GetPrice`, `GetTaxes`, `GetImageLink` and `glob` have no error handling.
- Z_DeleteCreditNote: every query passes `ErrMsg` and `true`. A failure leaves the uncommitted transaction. No existence check is shown.

## Connections
- `webERP/CreditItemsControlled.php`:
  - Reached by link from controlled lines, with `identifier` and `LineNo`.
  - Guards:
    - Missing `identifier` -> error and exit.
    - Missing `LineNo` (GET or POST) -> error and exit.
    - No session cart `CreditItems<id>` -> error and exit.
    - Line `Controlled != 1` -> warning and exit.
  - Includes `includes/InputSerialItems.php` with `LocationOut = Cart Location`, `ItemMustExist = SESSION['CreditingControlledItems_MustExist']`, `StockID`, `InOutModifier=1`, `ShowExisting=false`, `IsCredit=true`.
  - Delete: GET `Delete` unsets that serial item. The total then goes to `LineItems[LineNo]->QtyDispatched` when `CreditLink=='Credit_Invoice.php?identifier=<id>'`, else to `Quantity`.
- `webERP/Credit_Invoice.php`: the other path that fills `CreditItems<id>` (from an invoice). Detail not read.
- Helper functions whose behaviour is outside this topic: `GetPrice`, `GetNextTransNo(11)`, `GetPeriod`, `GetCOGSGLAccount`, `GetStockGLCode`, `GetSalesGLAccount`, `EnsureGLEntriesBalance`, `DB_Txn_*`, and the Cart methods (`add_to_cart`, `update_cart_item`, `remove_from_cart`, `GetTaxes`, `GetFreightTaxes`). The Cart class file was not found by name.
- `webERP/install/sql/data/scripts.sql` lists Z_DeleteCreditNote.php as a script. It has no menu entry in the files read.

## Conclusions
- Lines with `Quantity <= 0` are dropped from posting. A controlled line starts at Quantity 0 and is dropped unless serials are entered, so it posts only after serial entry.
- `ReverseOverCharge` changes no stock quantity. It writes a hidden stock move and a sales analysis reduction of amount and discount only. It skips the COGS credit, but see the note above on the stock-account debit.
- The location list is limited to locations with `canupd=1` for the user. The POSTed `Location` is later used without re-checking that permission.
- The posting path has no duplicate guard beyond the session being unset. A repeat POST gets "already processed" only because the session key is gone. With a reused `identifier` from a second tab, a second credit can be processed.
- `Z_DeleteCreditNote` removes salesanalysis rows. The source marks this "unreliable" because rows hold totals. It also zeroes nothing that the original posting left in `Credit_Invoice` links.
- Z_DeleteCreditNote reverses locstock with the stored move quantity and reverses `salesorderdetails.qtyinvoiced`. It does not undo bank or other GL outside type 11.
- All user input goes straight into SQL (`NewItem`, `Location`, `CreditNoteNo`) without escaping. This is a SQL-injection risk.
- The `DB_query` fourth parameter `true` and the lack of an explicit rollback mean a failure mid-posting leaves partial data unless `DB_query` aborts and rolls back (behaviour not in this topic).

## Hazards
- Currency rate division with no zero check in the header GL (`/CurrencyRate`). The line SalesValue guards `>0`.
- Serial and tax inserts rely on an unchecked `StkMoveNo`.
- Serial `BundleRef` and `WriteOffGLCode` are not validated against any table.
- Nothing is shown that restricts who can run Z_DeleteCreditNote.php, and there is no `CreditNoteNo` existence check.
- Z_DeleteCreditNote: a missing credit note number leads to an empty-arguments deletion. If the script does not stop after the "required parameter" message, the later deletes run with an empty number.

## Open first
- `webERP/SelectCreditItems.php`: the whole credit entry and posting flow.
- `webERP/CreditItemsControlled.php`: serial entry for controlled lines.
- `webERP/Z_DeleteCreditNote.php`: reversal utility.

114	  - `locations` by loccode gives taxprovinceid, kept as `$DispTaxProvinceID`. Error: "Could not retrieve the tax province of the location...".
115	- `GetNextTransNo(10)` gives the invoice number. It runs `SELECT typeno FROM systypes WHERE typeid=... FOR UPDATE`, then `UPDATE systypes SET typeno = typeno + 1` (the rest of the function was not read).
116	- `GetPeriod(date(DefaultDateFormat))` gives the period. It parses the date by separators `/`, `-` or `.`, and has a `$UseProhibit=true` parameter that checks prohibited posting dates. The rest of its body was not read. It uses today's date, not `$DelDate`.
117	- `DB_Txn_Begin`.
118	- Per line:
119	  - `LineNetAmount = unitprice*quantity*(1-discountpercent)`.
120	  - Tax rates come from `taxauthrates` INNER JOIN `taxgrouptaxes` INNER JOIN `taxauthorities`, by the branch's taxgroupid, the dispatch province and the item's taxcatid, in `calculationorder`.
121	  - `if taxontax==1` -> `TaxAuthAmount=(LineNetAmount+LineTaxAmount)*taxrate`, else `LineNetAmount*taxrate`.
122	  - The amounts accumulate into `TaxTotals[taxauthid]` and `LineTaxes[$LineCounter][calculationorder]`.
123	  - UPDATE `salesorderdetails` SET `qtyinvoiced += quantity`, `actualdispatchdate`, `completed='1'`.
124	  - INSERT `stockmoves` with type='10', transno=InvoiceNo, loccode=fromstkloc, trandate=DelDate, qty = -quantity, standardcost='0', price converted by `CurrencyRate`, prd=PeriodNo, reference=OrderNo.
125	  - Read `DB_Last_Insert_ID('stockmoves','stkmoveno')`, then INSERT `stockmovestaxes` per `LineTaxes` row.
126	  - SELECT COUNT from `salesanalysis` matching ordertype, period, customer, branch, stock, category and `budgetoractual='1'`. If count > 0 -> UPDATE amt, qty and disc. Else -> INSERT `salesanalysis` from `stockmaster` and `custbranch`, with cost='0'.
127	- GL postings:
128	  - `if CompanyRecord['gllink_debtors']==1 AND unitprice!=0` -> `GetSalesGLAccount(Area, stkcode, ordertype)` (behaviour not in this topic) returns `salesglcode` and `discountglcode`.
129	    - INSERT `gltrans` type '10' on salesglcode, amount `-unitprice*quantity/CurrencyRate`.
130	    - `if discountpercent!=0` -> INSERT `gltrans` on discountglcode, amount `unitprice*quantity*discountpercent/CurrencyRate`.
131	    - COGS is deliberately not posted, because only dummy items are expected.
132	  - After the lines, if gllink_debtors==1 and TaxAuthAmount != 0:
133	    - `foreach TaxTotals` -> INSERT `gltrans` on `Tax['GLCode']`, amount `-FXAmount/CurrencyRate`.
134	    - `if TotalInvLocalCurr != 0` -> INSERT `gltrans` on `CompanyRecord['debtorsact']`, amount `TotalInvLocalCurr`.
135	    - `if freightcost != 0` -> INSERT `gltrans` on `CompanyRecord['freightact']`, amount `-freightcost/CurrencyRate`.
136	- Closing writes:
137	  - UPDATE `salesorders` SET `comments=CONCAT(comments,' Inv ',InvoiceNo)`.
138	  - INSERT `debtortrans` with type=10, transno=InvoiceNo, ovamount=TotalFXNetInvoice, ovgst=TotalFXTax, ovfreight=freightcost, rate=CurrencyRate, order_=OrderNo, tpe=sales_type.
139	  - `DB_Last_Insert_ID('debtortrans','id')`, then INSERT `debtortranstaxes` (debtortransid, taxauthid, taxamount).
140	  - `DB_Txn_Commit`, then `prnMsg` and the text is added to `EmailText`.
141	
142	### Email advice
143	- `if IsEmailAddress($RecurrOrderRow['email'])`:
144	  - `IsEmailAddress` returns false when there is no '@', when there is a `..`, and on component-length limits (rest not read).
145	  - From is `coyname<email>` of CompanyRecord. Subject is 'Recurring Order Created Advice'. Body is `$EmailText`.
146	  - `SendEmailFromWebERP` returns true or an error. If the send fails -> `prnMsg` error "Failed to send email advice ... to [email]". On success there is no output.
147	  - If `$_SESSION['SmtpSetting']==0` it takes a local-mail path; otherwise another path (not read).
148	- Else -> warn 'No email advice sent, location has no email contact with valid email address'.
149	- The `email` read here comes from the joined row. Whether it comes from the location or the template's `contactemail` is not shown.
150	
151	### Z_SalesIntegrityCheck.php (each a report line, no change)
152	- type 10 `debtortrans` with no `salesorders` orderno -> "No Sales Order".
153	- type 10 `debtortrans` with no `debtortranstaxes` -> "Has no Tax Entry".
154	- type 10 `debtortrans` with no `gltrans` type 10 -> "has no GL Entry".
155	- `gltrans` type 10 with no `debtortrans` type 10 -> "Invoice could not be found".
156	- type 12 `gltrans` on `debtorsact` whose total does not balance against `debtortrans` type 12 `ovamount` -> reports the amounts.
157	- `debtortrans` type 12 with no `gltrans` type 12 -> "not found in GL".
158	- `salesorders` with no `debtortrans` type 10 -> "Has no Invoice".
159	- `salesorderdetails` with no `salesorders` -> "Has no Sales Order".
160	- `salesorderdetails` invoice total differing from `debtortrans` `ovamount` where the `debtortrans` type != 11 -> "Debtors trans differ from salesorderdetails".
161	- `stockmoves` transno with no `debtortrans` type 10 or 11 -> "Has no Invoice".
162	- `debtortranstaxes` with no `debtortrans` type 10 or 11 -> "Has no Invoice".
163	
164	## Order and failure
165	- Template save: the insert is wrapped in `DB_Txn_Begin` ... `DB_Txn_Commit`. The header and line inserts pass `$ErrMsg` 'The recurring order cannot be added because'. A failing DB_query reports and stops, and the transaction is not committed. The update path has no transaction.
166	- Template delete: lines are deleted first, then the header. There are no explicit transactions or error handlers.
167	- The process job's order creation is transactional: a failed `salesorderdetails` insert stops later steps, including the `lastrecurrence` update and the commit.
168	- Invoicing: every `DB_query` passes `CRITICAL ERROR ... NOTE DOWN THIS ERROR AND SEEK ASSISTANCE` with a specific reason. The error handling is done inside `DB_query`, which is not in this topic. The GL-posting chunk and the per-line chunk have no transaction wrapper of their own, but `DB_Txn_Begin` is called before the per-line loop.
169	- Nothing handles failures of `GetNextTransNo`, `GetPeriod`, `InsertGLTags`, `DB_Last_Insert_ID` or `DB_Txn_Commit`.
170	- The email step runs after the commit. Its failure only prints a message, and the invoice stays.
171	- The job loops once over each due template. It has no retry. Templates that fail are picked up again on the next run if `lastrecurrence` was not updated.
172	
173	## Connections
174	- `webERP/DeliveryDetails.php` sends the user to the template page with `identifier` and `NewRecurringOrder=Yes`. The session cart `Items<identifier>` is the data carrier.
175	- `webERP/SelectRecurringSalesOrder.php` links to modify, with `ModifyRecurringSalesOrder=<recurrorderno>`.
176	- `webERP/includes/ConnectDB_mysqli.php`, `ConnectDB_mysql.php` and `ConnectDB_mariadb.php` carry a comment that they handle `$_SESSION['DatabaseName']` for cron runs of `RecurringSalesOrdersProcess.php`. Each file has a @todo asking whether that is needed.
177	- `webERP/includes/SQL_CommonFunctions.php` provides `GetNextTransNo`, which uses table `systypes`.
178	- `webERP/includes/DateFunctions.php` provides `GetPeriod`.
179	- `webERP/includes/MiscFunctions.php` provides `IsEmailAddress` and `SendEmailFromWebERP`.
180	- Tables shared with other parts: `custbranch`, `stockmaster`, `locstock`, `locations`, `locationusers`, `debtorsmaster`, `salestypes`, `salesorders`, `salesorderdetails`, `stockmoves`, `stockmovestaxes`, `salesanalysis`, `gltrans`, `debtortrans`, `debtortranstaxes`, `taxauthrates`, `taxgrouptaxes`, `taxauthorities`, `currencies`, `systypes`.
181	- The recurring tables are also referenced by Z_ChangeBranchCode.php, Z_ChangeCustomerCode.php and Z_ChangeLocationCode.php. Those files were not read.
182	- `webERP/Z_SalesIntegrityCheck.php` checks the records that the invoice branch writes. It is not called by the other files.
183	
184	## Conclusions
185	- The due test, `(TO_DAYS(NOW()) - TO_DAYS(lastrecurrence)) > 365/frequency`, uses days. A monthly template (12) is due after more than 30.4 days, a weekly one (52) after more than 7.02 days, and an annual one (1) after more than 365 days.
186	- The second due condition, `lastrecurrence + 365/frequency days <= stopdate`, drops templates whose next date falls after `stopdate`. So a template stops generating before `stopdate`, and expired templates are never picked up.
187	- `DB_num_rows == 0` ends the run with only a warning. Nothing else runs.
188	- The locationusers join with `canupd=1` for `$_SESSION['UserID']` means the run only processes templates whose `fromstkloc` that user may update. When it runs from cron with no logged-in user, which templates are seen depends on that session user. Templates at other locations are silently left unprocessed.
189	- Each run creates at most one order per template (one `lastrecurrence` step). A template that is far behind catches up one period per run.
190	- `lastrecurrence` is set to `$DelDate`, and `GetPeriod` uses today's date. The order is dated at the computed recurrence date and the posting period is the current one.
191	- The same template run twice in a row: after a success `lastrecurrence` has advanced, so the second run does not create a second order. If the commit failed, the first order is not kept and the template is picked up again.
192	- `frequency` is stored as tinyint. The code divides `365 / frequency` with no check for zero. The form only offers 52, 26, 12, 6, 4, 2, 1, but the form does not validate posted values.
193	- The `AutoInvoice` choice is only offered when `AllDummyLineItems()` is true, so stocked items are never invoiced automatically through this path. Otherwise the hidden value is 0. The invoice branch posts no COGS, which fits that restriction. But the process job re-tests only `autoinvoice == 1` from the template, and a posted `AutoInvoice=1` is not re-checked against the lines when saved.
194	- Update of a template writes only the header. Line changes made in the cart are not written to `recurrsalesorderdetails` on update.
195	- The quotation check tests `isset($_POST['MakeRecurringOrder']) AND $_POST['Quotation']==1`. When `MakeRecurringOrder` is not posted, a quotation template is not refused.
196	- `contactemail` is varchar(25). Longer addresses are truncated or rejected, depending on the SQL mode.
197	- The integrity check reports problems the invoicing branch can create. Examples are an order without a debtortrans, or a debtortrans without GL, when a step fails with no wrapping transaction. The check reports lines only and repairs nothing.
198	- The `salesorderdetails` total test excludes only debtortrans type 11. So type 10 invoices are compared, as are types other than 11.
199	- Z_SalesIntegrityCheck has no guard: any caller that reaches the page gets the report.
200	- Changing the recurring table columns would not change `Z_ChangeBranchCode.php`, `Z_ChangeCustomerCode.php` or `Z_ChangeLocationCode.php`, which keep their own references to these tables.
201	
202	## Hazards
203	- Database name from `$_GET['Database']` or `$argv[1]` is unvalidated, and it chooses the company database for the whole run.
204	- No permission check on template create, modify or delete. Any user who reaches the page can change or delete any `recurrorderno`.
205	- The tax-GL block is gated by `TaxAuthAmount != 0` and `gllink_debtors==1`. With gllink_debtors off no `gltrans` rows are written, while `debtortrans`, `stockmoves` and `salesanalysis` still are.
206	- The debtors-account and freight GL inserts sit inside the `TaxAuthAmount != 0` gate in the source text given. A zero-tax invoice then posts no debtors or freight GL lines, so GL for that invoice would be missing or unbalanced (this reading follows the RULE text).
207	- Delete removes details then header with no transaction. A failure between them leaves a header with no lines.
208	- The email send runs after the commit, so a send failure never undoes the invoice. It is only printed.
209	- An empty template (no lines) can be saved. The line loop simply inserts nothing.
210	- No check that the customer, stock items or locations still exist when the job runs. The foreign keys on the tables are the only guard.
211	- Prices and quantities are not tested for being non-negative.
212	- No duplicate guard on `InvoiceNo` beyond `systypes` numbering.
213

# webERP recurring sales orders: template maintenance, due-order processing, and the sales integrity check

Part of [webERP: sales, purchasing, stock, manufacturing, master data, reporting, API…](weberp-sales-purchasing-stock-manufacturing-master-data-repo-151/brief.md) (path from the export's root): its brief says how work moves through the area and what repairs a failed step.

Three files make up this topic:
- `webERP/RecurringSalesOrders.php` creates, updates and deletes recurring order templates.
- `webERP/RecurringSalesOrdersProcess.php` is a cron or URL job. It turns due templates into sales orders and, optionally, invoices.
- `webERP/Z_SalesIntegrityCheck.php` is a read-only report on mismatched sales records.

The template page takes its starting data from the order entry screen's session cart. The process job writes `salesorders`, `salesorderdetails`, `stockmoves`, `gltrans`, `debtortrans` and related tables.

## Contract

### RecurringSalesOrders.php

**Input**
- `$_GET['identifier']` is the session cart key, `Items<identifier>`. It defaults to `date('U')`.
- `$_GET['NewRecurringOrder']` or `$_POST['NewRecurringOrder']` sets `$NewRecurringOrder` to 'Yes', otherwise 'No'.
- `$_GET['ModifyRecurringSalesOrder']` carries a `recurrorderno`.
- `$_POST['ExistingRecurrOrderNo']`, `$_POST['DeleteRecurringOrder']`, `$_POST['Process']`, `$_POST['StartDate']`, `$_POST['StopDate']`, `$_POST['Quotation']` and `$_POST['MakeRecurringOrder']` come from the form.
- `$_POST['Frequency']` takes one of 52, 26, 12, 6, 4, 2, 1. The labels are Weekly, Fortnightly, Monthly, Bi-monthly, Quarterly, Bi-Annually, Annually.
- `$_POST['AutoInvoice']` is 0 or 1.

**Who sends to it (live callers)**
- `source/webERP/DeliveryDetails.php:276` redirects to `RecurringSalesOrders.php?identifier=<id>&NewRecurringOrder=Yes`.
- `source/webERP/SelectRecurringSalesOrder.php:98` links to `RecurringSalesOrders.php?ModifyRecurringSalesOrder=<recurrorderno>`.

**Writes**
- `recurringsalesorders` header: debtorno, branchcode, customerref, comments, orddate (current date), ordertype, deliverto, deladd1-6, contactphone, contactemail, freightcost, fromstkloc, shipvia, lastrecurrence (from StartDate), stopdate (from StopDate), frequency, autoinvoice.
- `recurrsalesorderdetails` lines: recurrorderno, stkcode, unitprice, quantity, discountpercent, narrative.

**Table definitions**
- `recurringsalesorders`: PK `recurrorderno` auto-increment. Foreign key (branchcode, debtorno) -> `custbranch`.
  - `frequency` is tinyint, default 1.
  - `autoinvoice` is tinyint, default 0.
  - `lastrecurrence` and `stopdate` are date columns.
  - `contactemail` is varchar(25).
  - `contactphone` is varchar(25).
  - `comments` is longblob.
- `recurrsalesorderdetails`: recurrorderno is a foreign key to `recurringsalesorders`. stkcode is a foreign key to `stockmaster.stockid`. unitprice, quantity and discountpercent are doubles. narrative is text.

### RecurringSalesOrdersProcess.php

**Input**
- `$_GET['Database']` or `$argv[1]` sets `$_SESSION['DatabaseName']`, `$DatabaseName` and `$_POST['CompanyNameField']`.
- Cron form: `php -f RecurringSalesOrdersProcess.php "weberpdemo"`. URL form: `?Database=weberpdemo`.
- The menu (`install/sql/data/menuitems.sql`) lists it as "Process Recurring Orders" under Sales > Transactions.
- `$_SESSION['UserID']` is used in the location filter.

**Output**
- `salesorders`, `salesorderdetails`, `recurringsalesorders.lastrecurrence`.
- When `autoinvoice == 1`: `stockmoves` (type 10), `stockmovestaxes`, `salesanalysis`, `gltrans` (type 10), `debtortrans` (type 10), `debtortranstaxes`.
- An update to `salesorders.comments` appending ' Inv <InvoiceNo>'.
- An email advice.

### Z_SalesIntegrityCheck.php
It is requested as a page and runs read-only SELECTs on `debtortrans`, `salesorders`, `debtortranstaxes`, `gltrans`, `salesorderdetails` and `stockmoves`.

## Entry points and guards

### RecurringSalesOrders.php
1. `if isset($_GET['NewRecurringOrder']) or isset($_POST['NewRecurringOrder'])` -> `$NewRecurringOrder='Yes'`, else 'No'.
2. `if isset($_GET['ModifyRecurringSalesOrder'])` -> load the template into the Cart. It selects `recurringsalesorders` joined to `debtorsmaster` and `salestypes`, and lines from `recurrsalesorderdetails` joined to `stockmaster` and `locstock`. Each line is added with `Cart::add_to_cart()`.
   - `else if !isset($_POST['NewRecurringOrder'])` -> error, exit.
3. `if (!isset($_SESSION['Items'.$identifier]) OR ItemsOrdered == 0) AND $NewRecurringOrder == 'Yes'` -> error "A new recurring order can only be created if an order template has already been created from the normal order entry screen", exit.
4. `if isset($_POST['DeleteRecurringOrder'])` -> DELETE `recurrsalesorderdetails` WHERE recurrorderno, then DELETE `recurringsalesorders` WHERE recurrorderno. Message "Successfully deleted", unset Items, exit.
5. `if isset($_POST['Process'])` -> validation, in order. Each failure sets `$InputErrors=1`:
   - `if !Is_Date(StartDate)` -> error.
   - `if !Is_Date(StopDate)` -> error.
   - `if Date1GreaterThanDate2(StartDate, StopDate)` -> "end date ... must be after the start date".
   - `if isset($_POST['MakeRecurringOrder']) AND $_POST['Quotation']==1` -> "A recurring order cannot be made from a quotation".
   - `if $InputErrors == 0` -> save. Otherwise no database work and the form is shown again.

No permission check is shown on modify, delete or save.

### RecurringSalesOrdersProcess.php
There is no authentication guard of its own; `session.php` is included.
- `if isset($_GET['Database'])` -> set the database name. `if isset($argv[1])` -> set the database name. The name is not validated, and the file carries @todo comments about a whitelist.
- Due selection query:
  - Tables: `recurringsalesorders` INNER JOIN `locationusers` (loccode = fromstkloc, userid = `$_SESSION['UserID']`, canupd=1), `debtorsmaster`, `custbranch`, `salestypes`, `locations`.
  - WHERE: `(TO_DAYS(NOW()) - TO_DAYS(lastrecurrence)) > (365/frequency) AND DATE_ADD(lastrecurrence, INTERVAL (365/frequency) DAY) <= stopdate`.
- `if DB_num_rows == 0` -> warn "There are no recurring order templates that are due to have another recurring order created", include the footer, exit.
- Otherwise it prints "The number of recurring orders to process is : N".
- Then it loops `while ($RecurrOrderRow = DB_fetch_array($RecurrOrdersDueResult))`.

## Decisions

### RecurringSalesOrders.php (`RecurringSalesOrders.php` main flow)
- `$NewRecurringOrder=='Yes'` -> `DB_Txn_Begin`, INSERT header, `DB_Last_Insert_ID('recurringsalesorders','recurrorderno')`, INSERT one `recurrsalesorderdetails` row per cart line, `DB_Txn_Commit`. Message "The new recurring order template has been added".
- `$NewRecurringOrder` is not 'Yes' -> UPDATE `recurringsalesorders` WHERE `recurrorderno=$_POST['ExistingRecurrOrderNo']`. Message "The recurring order template has been updated".
  - An update changes only the header; lines are not rewritten.
  - On update `StartDate` is a hidden field, shown as "Last Recurrence".
- `!isset($_POST['StartDate'])` -> default is today in `DefaultDateFormat`.
- `!isset($_POST['StopDate'])` -> default is today plus 1 day and plus 1 year.
- `AllDummyLineItems()==true` -> the AutoInvoice select (0=No, 1=Yes) is shown. `AllDummyLineItems()==false` -> hidden `AutoInvoice=0`.
- `$_POST[AutoInvoice]==0` -> "No" selected. Anything else -> "Yes" selected.
- `$NewRecurringOrder=='Yes'` -> hidden NewRecurringOrder=Yes and a "Create Recurring Order" button.
- `$NewRecurringOrder` is not 'Yes' -> hidden NewRecurringOrder=No, hidden ExistingRecurrOrderNo, an "Update Recurring Order Details" button, and a "Delete Recurring Order N" reset button with a confirm prompt.

### RecurringSalesOrdersProcess.php: order creation
- Next date is `365 / frequency` days after `lastrecurrence`. The result is `$DelDate`.
- `DB_Txn_Begin`, then:
  1. INSERT `salesorders`. Error "The order cannot be added because".
  2. SELECT `recurrsalesorderdetails` INNER JOIN `stockmaster`. Error "The line items of the recurring order cannot be retrieved because".
  3. If `DB_num_rows($LineItemsResult) > 0` -> INSERT `salesorderdetails` per line, with `LineCounter` incremented. Error "Could not insert the order lines from the recurring order template".
  4. UPDATE `recurringsalesorders` SET `lastrecurrence=$DelDate`. Error "Could not update the last recurrence of the recurring order template. The database reported the error:".
  5. Commit.
- `autoinvoice == 1` -> invoice branch. The source text shown here is incomplete around where it branches.

### Invoice branch
- Look-ups:
  - `custbranch` by debtorno and branchcode gives area and defaultshipvia. Error: "Unable to determine the area where the sale is to...".
  - `currencies` INNER JOIN `debtorsmaster` gives the rate. Error: "The exchange rate for the customer currency could not be retrieved...".
  - `locations` by loccode gives taxprovinceid, kept as `$DispTaxProvinceID`. Error: "Could not retrieve the tax province of the location...".
- `GetNextTransNo(10)` gives the invoice number. It runs `SELECT typeno FROM systypes WHERE typeid=... FOR UPDATE`, then `UPDATE systypes SET typeno = typeno + 1` (the rest of the function was not read).
- `GetPeriod(date(DefaultDateFormat))` gives the period. It parses the date by separators `/`, `-` or `.`, and has a `$UseProhibit=true` parameter that checks prohibited posting dates. The rest of its body was not read. It uses today's date, not `$DelDate`.
- `DB_Txn_Begin`.
- Per line:
  - `LineNetAmount = unitprice*quantity*(1-discountpercent)`.
  - Tax rates come from `taxauthrates` INNER JOIN `taxgrouptaxes` INNER JOIN `taxauthorities`, by the branch's taxgroupid, the dispatch province and the item's taxcatid, in `calculationorder`.
  - `if taxontax==1` -> `TaxAuthAmount=(LineNetAmount+LineTaxAmount)*taxrate`, else `LineNetAmount*taxrate`.
  - The amounts accumulate into `TaxTotals[taxauthid]` and `LineTaxes[$LineCounter][calculationorder]`.
  - UPDATE `salesorderdetails` SET `qtyinvoiced += quantity`, `actualdispatchdate`, `completed='1'`.
  - INSERT `stockmoves` with type='10', transno=InvoiceNo, loccode=fromstkloc, trandate=DelDate, qty = -quantity, standardcost='0', price converted by `CurrencyRate`, prd=PeriodNo, reference=OrderNo.
  - Read `DB_Last_Insert_ID('stockmoves','stkmoveno')`, then INSERT `stockmovestaxes` per `LineTaxes` row.
  - SELECT COUNT from `salesanalysis` matching ordertype, period, customer, branch, stock, category and `budgetoractual='1'`. If count > 0 -> UPDATE amt, qty and disc. Else -> INSERT `salesanalysis` from `stockmaster` and `custbranch`, with cost='0'.
- GL postings:
  - `if CompanyRecord['gllink_debtors']==1 AND unitprice!=0` -> `GetSalesGLAccount(Area, stkcode, ordertype)` (behaviour not in this topic) returns `salesglcode` and `discountglcode`.
    - INSERT `gltrans` type '10' on salesglcode, amount `-unitprice*quantity/CurrencyRate`.
    - `if discountpercent!=0` -> INSERT `gltrans` on discountglcode, amount `unitprice*quantity*discountpercent/CurrencyRate`.
    - COGS is deliberately not posted, because only dummy items are expected.
  - After the lines, if gllink_debtors==1 and TaxAuthAmount != 0:
    - `foreach TaxTotals` -> INSERT `gltrans` on `Tax['GLCode']`, amount `-FXAmount/CurrencyRate`.
    - `if TotalInvLocalCurr != 0` -> INSERT `gltrans` on `CompanyRecord['debtorsact']`, amount `TotalInvLocalCurr`.
    - `if freightcost != 0` -> INSERT `gltrans` on `CompanyRecord['freightact']`, amount `-freightcost/CurrencyRate`.
- Closing writes:
  - UPDATE `salesorders` SET `comments=CONCAT(comments,' Inv ',InvoiceNo)`.
  - INSERT `debtortrans` with type=10, transno=InvoiceNo, ovamount=TotalFXNetInvoice, ovgst=TotalFXTax, ovfreight=freightcost, rate=CurrencyRate, order_=OrderNo, tpe=sales_type.
  - `DB_Last_Insert_ID('debtortrans','id')`, then INSERT `debtortranstaxes` (debtortransid, taxauthid, taxamount).
  - `DB_Txn_Commit`, then `prnMsg` and the text is added to `EmailText`.

### Email advice
- `if IsEmailAddress($RecurrOrderRow['email'])`:
  - `IsEmailAddress` returns false when there is no '@', when there is a `..`, and on component-length limits (rest not read).
  - From is `coyname<email>` of CompanyRecord. Subject is 'Recurring Order Created Advice'. Body is `$EmailText`.
  - `SendEmailFromWebERP` returns true or an error. If the send fails -> `prnMsg` error "Failed to send email advice ... to [email]". On success there is no output.
  - If `$_SESSION['SmtpSetting']==0` it takes a local-mail path; otherwise another path (not read).
- Else -> warn 'No email advice sent, location has no email contact with valid email address'.
- The `email` read here comes from the joined row. Whether it comes from the location or the template's `contactemail` is not shown.

### Z_SalesIntegrityCheck.php (each a report line, no change)
- type 10 `debtortrans` with no `salesorders` orderno -> "No Sales Order".
- type 10 `debtortrans` with no `debtortranstaxes` -> "Has no Tax Entry".
- type 10 `debtortrans` with no `gltrans` type 10 -> "has no GL Entry".
- `gltrans` type 10 with no `debtortrans` type 10 -> "Invoice could not be found".
- type 12 `gltrans` on `debtorsact` whose total does not balance against `debtortrans` type 12 `ovamount` -> reports the amounts.
- `debtortrans` type 12 with no `gltrans` type 12 -> "not found in GL".
- `salesorders` with no `debtortrans` type 10 -> "Has no Invoice".
- `salesorderdetails` with no `salesorders` -> "Has no Sales Order".
- `salesorderdetails` invoice total differing from `debtortrans` `ovamount` where the `debtortrans` type != 11 -> "Debtors trans differ from salesorderdetails".
- `stockmoves` transno with no `debtortrans` type 10 or 11 -> "Has no Invoice".
- `debtortranstaxes` with no `debtortrans` type 10 or 11 -> "Has no Invoice".

## Order and failure
- Template save: the insert is wrapped in `DB_Txn_Begin` ... `DB_Txn_Commit`. The header and line inserts pass `$ErrMsg` 'The recurring order cannot be added because'. A failing DB_query reports and stops, and the transaction is not committed. The update path has no transaction.
- Template delete: lines are deleted first, then the header. There are no explicit transactions or error handlers.
- The process job's order creation is transactional: a failed `salesorderdetails` insert stops later steps, including the `lastrecurrence` update and the commit.
- Invoicing: every `DB_query` passes `CRITICAL ERROR ... NOTE DOWN THIS ERROR AND SEEK ASSISTANCE` with a specific reason. The error handling is done inside `DB_query`, which is not in this topic. The GL-posting chunk and the per-line chunk have no transaction wrapper of their own, but `DB_Txn_Begin` is called before the per-line loop.
- Nothing handles failures of `GetNextTransNo`, `GetPeriod`, `InsertGLTags`, `DB_Last_Insert_ID` or `DB_Txn_Commit`.
- The email step runs after the commit. Its failure only prints a message, and the invoice stays.
- The job loops once over each due template. It has no retry. Templates that fail are picked up again on the next run if `lastrecurrence` was not updated.

## Connections
- `webERP/DeliveryDetails.php` sends the user to the template page with `identifier` and `NewRecurringOrder=Yes`. The session cart `Items<identifier>` is the data carrier.
- `webERP/SelectRecurringSalesOrder.php` links to modify, with `ModifyRecurringSalesOrder=<recurrorderno>`.
- `webERP/includes/ConnectDB_mysqli.php`, `ConnectDB_mysql.php` and `ConnectDB_mariadb.php` carry a comment that they handle `$_SESSION['DatabaseName']` for cron runs of `RecurringSalesOrdersProcess.php`. Each file has a @todo asking whether that is needed.
- `webERP/includes/SQL_CommonFunctions.php` provides `GetNextTransNo`, which uses table `systypes`.
- `webERP/includes/DateFunctions.php` provides `GetPeriod`.
- `webERP/includes/MiscFunctions.php` provides `IsEmailAddress` and `SendEmailFromWebERP`.
- Tables shared with other parts: `custbranch`, `stockmaster`, `locstock`, `locations`, `locationusers`, `debtorsmaster`, `salestypes`, `salesorders`, `salesorderdetails`, `stockmoves`, `stockmovestaxes`, `salesanalysis`, `gltrans`, `debtortrans`, `debtortranstaxes`, `taxauthrates`, `taxgrouptaxes`, `taxauthorities`, `currencies`, `systypes`.
- The recurring tables are also referenced by Z_ChangeBranchCode.php, Z_ChangeCustomerCode.php and Z_ChangeLocationCode.php. Those files were not read.
- `webERP/Z_SalesIntegrityCheck.php` checks the records that the invoice branch writes. It is not called by the other files.

## Conclusions
- The due test, `(TO_DAYS(NOW()) - TO_DAYS(lastrecurrence)) > 365/frequency`, uses days. A monthly template (12) is due after more than 30.4 days, a weekly one (52) after more than 7.02 days, and an annual one (1) after more than 365 days.
- The second due condition, `lastrecurrence + 365/frequency days <= stopdate`, drops templates whose next date falls after `stopdate`. So a template stops generating before `stopdate`, and expired templates are never picked up.
- `DB_num_rows == 0` ends the run with only a warning. Nothing else runs.
- The locationusers join with `canupd=1` for `$_SESSION['UserID']` means the run only processes templates whose `fromstkloc` that user may update. When it runs from cron with no logged-in user, which templates are seen depends on that session user. Templates at other locations are silently left unprocessed.
- Each run creates at most one order per template (one `lastrecurrence` step). A template that is far behind catches up one period per run.
- `lastrecurrence` is set to `$DelDate`, and `GetPeriod` uses today's date. The order is dated at the computed recurrence date and the posting period is the current one.
- The same template run twice in a row: after a success `lastrecurrence` has advanced, so the second run does not create a second order. If the commit failed, the first order is not kept and the template is picked up again.
- `frequency` is stored as tinyint. The code divides `365 / frequency` with no check for zero. The form only offers 52, 26, 12, 6, 4, 2, 1, but the form does not validate posted values.
- The `AutoInvoice` choice is only offered when `AllDummyLineItems()` is true, so stocked items are never invoiced automatically through this path. Otherwise the hidden value is 0. The invoice branch posts no COGS, which fits that restriction. But the process job re-tests only `autoinvoice == 1` from the template, and a posted `AutoInvoice=1` is not re-checked against the lines when saved.
- Update of a template writes only the header. Line changes made in the cart are not written to `recurrsalesorderdetails` on update.
- The quotation check tests `isset($_POST['MakeRecurringOrder']) AND $_POST['Quotation']==1`. When `MakeRecurringOrder` is not posted, a quotation template is not refused.
- `contactemail` is varchar(25). Longer addresses are truncated or rejected, depending on the SQL mode.
- The integrity check reports problems the invoicing branch can create. Examples are an order without a debtortrans, or a debtortrans without GL, when a step fails with no wrapping transaction. The check reports lines only and repairs nothing.
- The `salesorderdetails` total test excludes only debtortrans type 11. So type 10 invoices are compared, as are types other than 11.
- Z_SalesIntegrityCheck has no guard: any caller that reaches the page gets the report.
- Changing the recurring table columns would not change `Z_ChangeBranchCode.php`, `Z_ChangeCustomerCode.php` or `Z_ChangeLocationCode.php`, which keep their own references to these tables.

## Hazards
- Database name from `$_GET['Database']` or `$argv[1]` is unvalidated, and it chooses the company database for the whole run.
- No permission check on template create, modify or delete. Any user who reaches the page can change or delete any `recurrorderno`.
- The tax-GL block is gated by `TaxAuthAmount != 0` and `gllink_debtors==1`. With gllink_debtors off no `gltrans` rows are written, while `debtortrans`, `stockmoves` and `salesanalysis` still are.
- The debtors-account and freight GL inserts sit inside the `TaxAuthAmount != 0` gate in the source text given. A zero-tax invoice then posts no debtors or freight GL lines, so GL for that invoice would be missing or unbalanced (this reading follows the RULE text).
- Delete removes details then header with no transaction. A failure between them leaves a header with no lines.
- The email send runs after the commit, so a send failure never undoes the invoice. It is only printed.
- An empty template (no lines) can be saved. The line loop simply inserts nothing.
- No check that the customer, stock items or locations still exist when the job runs. The foreign keys on the tables are the only guard.
- Prices and quantities are not tested for being non-negative.
- No duplicate guard on `InvoiceNo` beyond `systypes` numbering.
