<?php

/* Shared credit control functions.
 *
 * Credit status is the existing customer "credit status" (debtorsmaster.holdreason -> holdreasons.dissallowinvoices):
 * 0 = normal, 1 = on stop (no invoicing, no orders), 2 = on watch (supplied, but warned).
 * Every change of status, limit and every other credit control action is written to creditlog.
 */

define('CREDIT_TOKEN_CONTROL', 21);
define('CREDIT_TOKEN_APPROVE', 22);

define('CREDIT_TYPE_CHARGE', 51);
define('CREDIT_TYPE_WAIVER', 52);
define('CREDIT_TYPE_WRITEOFF', 53);

function CreditStatusText($Dissallow) {
	switch ($Dissallow) {
		case 1:
			return __('On stop');
		case 2:
			return __('On watch');
		default:
			return __('Normal');
	}
}

/* Can the logged in user change credit status, limits, run reminders etc? */
function CreditUserCanControl() {
	return in_array(CREDIT_TOKEN_CONTROL, $_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens']);
}

/* Can the logged in user approve write-offs and change credit control settings? */
function CreditUserCanApprove() {
	return in_array(CREDIT_TOKEN_APPROVE, $_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens']);
}

/* SQL fragment restricting debtorsmaster rows to the customers of the logged in sales rep, if the user is a sales rep.
 * $DebtorField is the qualified debtorno column of the query. */
function CreditSalesmanFilter($DebtorField = 'debtorsmaster.debtorno') {
	if (isset($_SESSION['SalesmanLogin']) and $_SESSION['SalesmanLogin'] != '') {
		return " AND " . $DebtorField . " IN (SELECT debtorno FROM custbranch WHERE salesman='" . $_SESSION['SalesmanLogin'] . "') ";
	}
	return '';
}

/* Is the customer visible to the logged in user? A customer login sees only its own account, a sales rep only own customers. */
function CreditCanSeeCustomer($DebtorNo) {
	global $CustomerLogin;
	if (isset($CustomerLogin) and $CustomerLogin == 1 and $_SESSION['CustomerID'] != $DebtorNo) {
		return false;
	}
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT debtorno FROM debtorsmaster WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'" . CreditSalesmanFilter('debtorsmaster.debtorno'));
	return DB_num_rows($Result) == 1;
}

/* Returns the credit status row of a customer or false if the customer does not exist */
function GetCreditStatus($DebtorNo) {
	$SQL = "SELECT debtorsmaster.debtorno,
					debtorsmaster.name,
					debtorsmaster.currcode,
					debtorsmaster.creditlimit,
					debtorsmaster.holdreason,
					debtorsmaster.nextcreditreview,
					debtorsmaster.interestexempt,
					debtorsmaster.feeexempt,
					holdreasons.reasondescription,
					holdreasons.dissallowinvoices
			FROM debtorsmaster
			INNER JOIN holdreasons
				ON debtorsmaster.holdreason = holdreasons.reasoncode
			WHERE debtorsmaster.debtorno = '" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL);
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
		return false;
	}
	return DB_fetch_array($Result);
}

/* The first credit status code of a kind (1 stop, 2 watch, 0 normal), or false if none is defined */
function GetCreditReasonCode($Kind) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT reasoncode FROM holdreasons WHERE dissallowinvoices = '" . (int) $Kind . "' ORDER BY reasoncode");
	if ($MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result)) {
		return $MyRow[0];
	}
	return false;
}

/* Is the customer on stop? Used by every route that takes or releases an order */
function CreditCustomerOnStop($DebtorNo) {
	$Status = GetCreditStatus($DebtorNo);
	return ($Status !== false and $Status['dissallowinvoices'] == 1);
}

/* Audit trail. Rows are only ever inserted. */
function LogCreditEvent($DebtorNo, $EventType, $Detail, $Reason = '', $OldValue = '', $NewValue = '', $TransType = 0, $TransNo = 0) {
	$SQL = "INSERT INTO creditlog (debtorno,
									logdate,
									userid,
									eventtype,
									detail,
									reason,
									oldvalue,
									newvalue,
									transtype,
									transno
								) VALUES (
									'" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "',
									'" . date('Y-m-d H:i:s') . "',
									'" . (isset($_SESSION['UserID']) ? $_SESSION['UserID'] : 'system') . "',
									'" . $EventType . "',
									'" . DB_escape_string(mb_substr($Detail, 0, 250)) . "',
									'" . DB_escape_string($Reason) . "',
									'" . DB_escape_string($OldValue) . "',
									'" . DB_escape_string($NewValue) . "',
									'" . (int) $TransType . "',
									'" . (int) $TransNo . "'
								)";
	DB_query($SQL, __('The credit control history could not be updated because'));
}

/* Change the credit status of a customer to the given credit status code, and log it with the reason */
function SetCreditStatus($DebtorNo, $ReasonCode, $Reason) {
	$Current = GetCreditStatus($DebtorNo);
	if ($Current === false or $Current['holdreason'] == $ReasonCode) {
		return;
	}
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT reasondescription FROM holdreasons WHERE reasoncode='" . (int) $ReasonCode . "'");
	$NewRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	DB_query("UPDATE debtorsmaster SET holdreason='" . (int) $ReasonCode . "' WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'",
			__('The credit status of the customer could not be updated because'));
	LogCreditEvent($DebtorNo, 'STATUS', __('Credit status changed'), $Reason, $Current['reasondescription'], $NewRow[0]);
}

/* Change the credit limit and log it */
function SetCreditLimit($DebtorNo, $NewLimit, $Reason) {
	$Current = GetCreditStatus($DebtorNo);
	if ($Current === false or $Current['creditlimit'] == $NewLimit) {
		return;
	}
	DB_query("UPDATE debtorsmaster SET creditlimit='" . (float) $NewLimit . "' WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'",
			__('The credit limit of the customer could not be updated because'));
	LogCreditEvent($DebtorNo, 'LIMIT', __('Credit limit changed'), $Reason, $Current['creditlimit'], $NewLimit);
}

/* The date a standard review period from today, as Y-m-d */
function CreditDefaultNextReview() {
	$Months = isset($_SESSION['CreditReviewMonths']) ? (int) $_SESSION['CreditReviewMonths'] : 12;
	return date('Y-m-d', mktime(0, 0, 0, date('n') + $Months, date('j'), date('Y')));
}

/* SQL expression for the due date of a debtor transaction. $Trans and $Terms are the table aliases */
function CreditDueDateSQL($Trans = 'debtortrans', $Terms = 'paymentterms') {
	return "CASE WHEN " . $Terms . ".daysbeforedue > 0
				THEN DATE_ADD(" . $Trans . ".trandate, INTERVAL " . $Terms . ".daysbeforedue DAY)
				ELSE DATE_ADD(LAST_DAY(" . $Trans . ".trandate), INTERVAL " . $Terms . ".dayinfollowingmonth DAY)
			END";
}

/* Overdue debit items (invoices, charges and debtor journals still owing) of one customer, or of all customers when
 * $DebtorNo is empty. Disputed items are only returned when $IncludeDisputed is true. */
function CreditOverdueItems($DebtorNo = '', $MinDaysOverdue = 1, $IncludeDisputed = false) {
	$SQL = "SELECT debtortrans.id,
					debtortrans.debtorno,
					debtortrans.transno,
					debtortrans.type,
					debtortrans.trandate,
					debtortrans.balance,
					debtortrans.disputed,
					debtortrans.rate,
					debtortrans.reference,
					" . CreditDueDateSQL() . " AS duedate,
					TO_DAYS(NOW()) - TO_DAYS(" . CreditDueDateSQL() . ") AS daysoverdue
			FROM debtortrans
			INNER JOIN debtorsmaster
				ON debtortrans.debtorno = debtorsmaster.debtorno
			INNER JOIN paymentterms
				ON debtorsmaster.paymentterms = paymentterms.termsindicator
			WHERE debtortrans.type NOT IN (" . CREDIT_TYPE_WAIVER . ", " . CREDIT_TYPE_WRITEOFF . ", 11, 12)
				AND debtortrans.balance > 0.005
				AND debtortrans.settled = 0" .
				($IncludeDisputed ? '' : " AND debtortrans.disputed = 0") .
				($DebtorNo != '' ? " AND debtortrans.debtorno = '" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'" : '') . "
			HAVING daysoverdue >= " . (int) $MinDaysOverdue . "
			ORDER BY debtortrans.debtorno, debtortrans.trandate";
	return DB_query($SQL, __('The overdue transactions could not be retrieved because'));
}

/* Net balance of all of a customer's transactions, in the customer's currency */
function CreditCustomerBalance($DebtorNo) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT SUM(balance) FROM debtortrans WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	return (float) $MyRow[0];
}

/* Exchange rate (customer currency per home currency) of a currency */
function CreditCurrencyRate($CurrCode) {
	if ($CurrCode == $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['currencydefault']) {
		return 1;
	}
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT rate FROM currencies WHERE currabrev='" . $CurrCode . "'");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	if ($MyRow and $MyRow[0] > 0) {
		return $MyRow[0];
	}
	return 1;
}

/* Number of decimal places of the currency */
function CreditCurrencyDecimals($CurrCode) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT decimalplaces FROM currencies WHERE currabrev='" . $CurrCode . "'");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	return $MyRow ? (int) $MyRow[0] : 2;
}

/* The first branch of a customer: debtor transactions need a branch */
function CreditFirstBranch($DebtorNo) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT branchcode, salesman FROM custbranch WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "' ORDER BY branchcode LIMIT 1");
	return DB_fetch_array($Result);
}

/* Post a debtor transaction and its general ledger entries. Must be called inside a transaction that the caller
 * commits. $Amount is signed, in the customer's currency (positive debits the customer). The ledger is posted at
 * $Rate: debtors control gets Amount/Rate and $CounterAccount gets the opposite. Returns array(id, transno). */
function CreditPostDebtorTrans($DebtorNo, $Type, $Amount, $Rate, $CounterAccount, $Narrative, $Reference = '') {
	$Branch = CreditFirstBranch($DebtorNo);
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT salestype FROM debtorsmaster WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	$SalesType = $MyRow[0];

	$TransNo = GetNextTransNo($Type);
	$PeriodNo = GetPeriod(date($_SESSION['DefaultDateFormat']));
	$TranDate = date('Y-m-d');

	$SQL = "INSERT INTO debtortrans (transno,
									type,
									debtorno,
									branchcode,
									trandate,
									inputdate,
									prd,
									reference,
									tpe,
									rate,
									ovamount,
									invtext,
									salesperson
								) VALUES (
									'" . $TransNo . "',
									'" . $Type . "',
									'" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "',
									'" . $Branch['branchcode'] . "',
									'" . $TranDate . "',
									'" . date('Y-m-d H:i:s') . "',
									'" . $PeriodNo . "',
									'" . DB_escape_string($Reference) . "',
									'" . $SalesType . "',
									'" . $Rate . "',
									'" . $Amount . "',
									'" . DB_escape_string($Narrative) . "',
									'" . $Branch['salesman'] . "'
								)";
	DB_query($SQL, __('The debtor transaction could not be inserted because'), __('The SQL used was'), true);
	$DebtorTransID = DB_Last_Insert_ID('debtortrans', 'id');

	if ($_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['gllink_debtors'] == 1) {
		$HomeAmount = round($Amount / $Rate, $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['decimalplaces']);
		if ($HomeAmount != 0) {
			$SQL = "INSERT INTO gltrans (type, typeno, trandate, periodno, account, narrative, amount)
					VALUES ('" . $Type . "',
							'" . $TransNo . "',
							'" . $TranDate . "',
							'" . $PeriodNo . "',
							'" . $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['debtorsact'] . "',
							'" . DB_escape_string(mb_substr($DebtorNo . ' ' . $Narrative, 0, 200)) . "',
							'" . $HomeAmount . "')";
			DB_query($SQL, __('The debtors control posting could not be inserted because'), __('The SQL used was'), true);
			$SQL = "INSERT INTO gltrans (type, typeno, trandate, periodno, account, narrative, amount)
					VALUES ('" . $Type . "',
							'" . $TransNo . "',
							'" . $TranDate . "',
							'" . $PeriodNo . "',
							'" . $CounterAccount . "',
							'" . DB_escape_string(mb_substr($DebtorNo . ' ' . $Narrative, 0, 200)) . "',
							'" . -$HomeAmount . "')";
			DB_query($SQL, __('The ledger posting could not be inserted because'), __('The SQL used was'), true);
		}
		EnsureGLEntriesBalance($Type, $TransNo);
	}
	return array($DebtorTransID, $TransNo);
}

/* Allocate $Amount of the credit transaction $FromID (receipt, credit, write-off, waiver) to the debit item $ToID.
 * Same bookkeeping as CustomerAllocations.php: custallocns, alloc and settled on both transactions. Call inside a
 * transaction. */
function CreditAllocate($FromID, $ToID, $Amount, $CurrCode) {
	$SQL = "INSERT INTO custallocns (datealloc, amt, transid_allocfrom, transid_allocto)
			VALUES (CURRENT_DATE, '" . $Amount . "', '" . $FromID . "', '" . $ToID . "')";
	DB_query($SQL, __('The allocation could not be inserted because'), __('The SQL used was'), true);

	$Tolerance = CurrencyTolerance($CurrCode);
	foreach (array($ToID => $Amount, $FromID => -$Amount) as $ID => $Movement) {
		$Result = DB_query("SELECT ovamount + ovgst + ovfreight + ovdiscount AS total, alloc FROM debtortrans WHERE id='" . $ID . "'");
		$MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result);
		$NewAlloc = $MyRow['alloc'] + $Movement;
		$Settled = (abs($MyRow['total'] - $NewAlloc) < $Tolerance) ? 1 : 0;
		DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans SET alloc='" . $NewAlloc . "', settled='" . $Settled . "' WHERE id='" . $ID . "'",
				__('The allocation could not be updated because'), __('The SQL used was'), true);
	}
}

/* Accounts contact email addresses of a customer: the contacts flagged to receive statements */
function CreditAccountsEmails($DebtorNo) {
	$Emails = array();
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT email FROM custcontacts WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "' AND statement=1");
	while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result)) {
		if (IsEmailAddress($MyRow[0])) {
			$Emails[] = $MyRow[0];
		}
	}
	return $Emails;
}

/* The last reminder stage sent to a customer, 0 if none */
function CreditLastReminderStage($DebtorNo) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT stage FROM dunninglog WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "' ORDER BY sentdate DESC, dunningid DESC LIMIT 1");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	return $MyRow ? (int) $MyRow[0] : 0;
}

function GetCreditStatus($DebtorNo) {
	$SQL = "SELECT debtorsmaster.debtorno,
					debtorsmaster.name,
					debtorsmaster.currcode,
					debtorsmaster.creditlimit,
					debtorsmaster.holdreason,
					debtorsmaster.nextcreditreview,
					debtorsmaster.interestexempt,
					debtorsmaster.feeexempt,
					holdreasons.reasondescription,
					holdreasons.dissallowinvoices
			FROM debtorsmaster
			INNER JOIN holdreasons
				ON debtorsmaster.holdreason = holdreasons.reasoncode
			WHERE debtorsmaster.debtorno = '" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL);
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
		return false;
	}
	return DB_fetch_array($Result);
}

/* The first credit status code of a kind (1 stop, 2 watch, 0 normal), or false if none is defined */
function GetCreditReasonCode($Kind) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT reasoncode FROM holdreasons WHERE dissallowinvoices = '" . (int) $Kind . "' ORDER BY reasoncode");
	if ($MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result)) {
		return $MyRow[0];
	}
	return false;
}

/* Is the customer on stop? Used by every route that takes or releases an order */
function CreditCustomerOnStop($DebtorNo) {
	$Status = GetCreditStatus($DebtorNo);
	return ($Status !== false and $Status['dissallowinvoices'] == 1);
}

/* Audit trail. Rows are only ever inserted. */
function LogCreditEvent($DebtorNo, $EventType, $Detail, $Reason = '', $OldValue = '', $NewValue = '', $TransType = 0, $TransNo = 0) {
	$SQL = "INSERT INTO creditlog (debtorno,
									logdate,
									userid,
									eventtype,
									detail,
									reason,
									oldvalue,
									newvalue,
									transtype,
									transno
								) VALUES (
									'" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "',
									'" . date('Y-m-d H:i:s') . "',
									'" . (isset($_SESSION['UserID']) ? $_SESSION['UserID'] : 'system') . "',
									'" . $EventType . "',
									'" . DB_escape_string(mb_substr($Detail, 0, 250)) . "',
									'" . DB_escape_string($Reason) . "',
									'" . DB_escape_string($OldValue) . "',
									'" . DB_escape_string($NewValue) . "',
									'" . (int) $TransType . "',
									'" . (int) $TransNo . "'
								)";
	DB_query($SQL, __('The credit control history could not be updated because'));
}

/* Change the credit status of a customer to the given credit status code, and log it with the reason */
function SetCreditStatus($DebtorNo, $ReasonCode, $Reason) {
	$Current = GetCreditStatus($DebtorNo);
	if ($Current === false or $Current['holdreason'] == $ReasonCode) {
		return;
	}
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT reasondescription FROM holdreasons WHERE reasoncode='" . (int) $ReasonCode . "'");
	$NewRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	DB_query("UPDATE debtorsmaster SET holdreason='" . (int) $ReasonCode . "' WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'",
			__('The credit status of the customer could not be updated because'));
	LogCreditEvent($DebtorNo, 'STATUS', __('Credit status changed'), $Reason, $Current['reasondescription'], $NewRow[0]);
}

/* Change the credit limit and log it */
function SetCreditLimit($DebtorNo, $NewLimit, $Reason) {
	$Current = GetCreditStatus($DebtorNo);
	if ($Current === false or $Current['creditlimit'] == $NewLimit) {
		return;
	}
	DB_query("UPDATE debtorsmaster SET creditlimit='" . (float) $NewLimit . "' WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'",
			__('The credit limit of the customer could not be updated because'));
	LogCreditEvent($DebtorNo, 'LIMIT', __('Credit limit changed'), $Reason, $Current['creditlimit'], $NewLimit);
}

/* The date a standard review period from today, as Y-m-d */
function CreditDefaultNextReview() {
	$Months = isset($_SESSION['CreditReviewMonths']) ? (int) $_SESSION['CreditReviewMonths'] : 12;
	return date('Y-m-d', mktime(0, 0, 0, date('n') + $Months, date('j'), date('Y')));
}

/* SQL expression for the due date of a debtor transaction. $Trans and $Terms are the table aliases */
function CreditDueDateSQL($Trans = 'debtortrans', $Terms = 'paymentterms') {
	return "CASE WHEN " . $Terms . ".daysbeforedue > 0
				THEN DATE_ADD(" . $Trans . ".trandate, INTERVAL " . $Terms . ".daysbeforedue DAY)
				ELSE DATE_ADD(LAST_DAY(" . $Trans . ".trandate), INTERVAL " . $Terms . ".dayinfollowingmonth DAY)
			END";
}

/* Overdue debit items (invoices, charges and debtor journals still owing) of one customer, or of all customers when
 * $DebtorNo is empty. Disputed items are only returned when $IncludeDisputed is true. */
function CreditOverdueItems($DebtorNo = '', $MinDaysOverdue = 1, $IncludeDisputed = false) {
	$SQL = "SELECT debtortrans.id,
					debtortrans.debtorno,
					debtortrans.transno,
					debtortrans.type,
					debtortrans.trandate,
					debtortrans.balance,
					debtortrans.disputed,
					debtortrans.rate,
					debtortrans.reference,
					" . CreditDueDateSQL() . " AS duedate,
					TO_DAYS(NOW()) - TO_DAYS(" . CreditDueDateSQL() . ") AS daysoverdue
			FROM debtortrans
			INNER JOIN debtorsmaster
				ON debtortrans.debtorno = debtorsmaster.debtorno
			INNER JOIN paymentterms
				ON debtorsmaster.paymentterms = paymentterms.termsindicator
			WHERE debtortrans.type NOT IN (" . CREDIT_TYPE_WAIVER . ", " . CREDIT_TYPE_WRITEOFF . ", 11, 12)
				AND debtortrans.balance > 0.005
				AND debtortrans.settled = 0" .
				($IncludeDisputed ? '' : " AND debtortrans.disputed = 0") .
				($DebtorNo != '' ? " AND debtortrans.debtorno = '" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'" : '') . "
			HAVING daysoverdue >= " . (int) $MinDaysOverdue . "
			ORDER BY debtortrans.debtorno, debtortrans.trandate";
	return DB_query($SQL, __('The overdue transactions could not be retrieved because'));
}

/* Net balance of all of a customer's transactions, in the customer's currency */
function CreditCustomerBalance($DebtorNo) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT SUM(balance) FROM debtortrans WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	return (float) $MyRow[0];
}

/* Exchange rate (customer currency per home currency) of a currency */
function CreditCurrencyRate($CurrCode) {
	if ($CurrCode == $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['currencydefault']) {
		return 1;
	}
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT rate FROM currencies WHERE currabrev='" . $CurrCode . "'");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	if ($MyRow and $MyRow[0] > 0) {
		return $MyRow[0];
	}
	return 1;
}

/* Number of decimal places of the currency */
function CreditCurrencyDecimals($CurrCode) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT decimalplaces FROM currencies WHERE currabrev='" . $CurrCode . "'");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	return $MyRow ? (int) $MyRow[0] : 2;
}

/* The first branch of a customer: debtor transactions need a branch */
function CreditFirstBranch($DebtorNo) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT branchcode, salesman FROM custbranch WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "' ORDER BY branchcode LIMIT 1");
	return DB_fetch_array($Result);
}

/* Post a debtor transaction and its general ledger entries. Must be called inside a transaction that the caller
 * commits. $Amount is signed, in the customer's currency (positive debits the customer). The ledger is posted at
 * $Rate: debtors control gets Amount/Rate and $CounterAccount gets the opposite. Returns array(id, transno). */
function CreditPostDebtorTrans($DebtorNo, $Type, $Amount, $Rate, $CounterAccount, $Narrative, $Reference = '', $HomeAmountOverride = null) {
	$Branch = CreditFirstBranch($DebtorNo);
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT salestype FROM debtorsmaster WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	$SalesType = $MyRow[0];

	$TransNo = GetNextTransNo($Type);
	$PeriodNo = GetPeriod(date($_SESSION['DefaultDateFormat']));
	$TranDate = date('Y-m-d');

	$SQL = "INSERT INTO debtortrans (transno,
									type,
									debtorno,
									branchcode,
									trandate,
									inputdate,
									prd,
									reference,
									tpe,
									rate,
									ovamount,
									invtext,
									salesperson
								) VALUES (
									'" . $TransNo . "',
									'" . $Type . "',
									'" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "',
									'" . $Branch['branchcode'] . "',
									'" . $TranDate . "',
									'" . date('Y-m-d H:i:s') . "',
									'" . $PeriodNo . "',
									'" . DB_escape_string($Reference) . "',
									'" . $SalesType . "',
									'" . $Rate . "',
									'" . $Amount . "',
									'" . DB_escape_string($Narrative) . "',
									'" . $Branch['salesman'] . "'
								)";
	DB_query($SQL, __('The debtor transaction could not be inserted because'), __('The SQL used was'), true);
	$DebtorTransID = DB_Last_Insert_ID('debtortrans', 'id');

	if ($_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['gllink_debtors'] == 1) {
		$HomeAmount = round($Amount / $Rate, $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['decimalplaces']);
		if ($HomeAmount != 0) {
			$SQL = "INSERT INTO gltrans (type, typeno, trandate, periodno, account, narrative, amount)
					VALUES ('" . $Type . "',
							'" . $TransNo . "',
							'" . $TranDate . "',
							'" . $PeriodNo . "',
							'" . $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['debtorsact'] . "',
							'" . DB_escape_string(mb_substr($DebtorNo . ' ' . $Narrative, 0, 200)) . "',
							'" . $HomeAmount . "')";
			DB_query($SQL, __('The debtors control posting could not be inserted because'), __('The SQL used was'), true);
			$SQL = "INSERT INTO gltrans (type, typeno, trandate, periodno, account, narrative, amount)
					VALUES ('" . $Type . "',
							'" . $TransNo . "',
							'" . $TranDate . "',
							'" . $PeriodNo . "',
							'" . $CounterAccount . "',
							'" . DB_escape_string(mb_substr($DebtorNo . ' ' . $Narrative, 0, 200)) . "',
							'" . -$HomeAmount . "')";
			DB_query($SQL, __('The ledger posting could not be inserted because'), __('The SQL used was'), true);
		}
		EnsureGLEntriesBalance($Type, $TransNo);
	}
	return array($DebtorTransID, $TransNo);
}

/* Allocate $Amount of the credit transaction $FromID (receipt, credit, write-off, waiver) to the debit item $ToID.
 * Same bookkeeping as CustomerAllocations.php: custallocns, alloc and settled on both transactions. Call inside a
 * transaction. */
function CreditAllocate($FromID, $ToID, $Amount, $CurrCode) {
	$SQL = "INSERT INTO custallocns (datealloc, amt, transid_allocfrom, transid_allocto)
			VALUES (CURRENT_DATE, '" . $Amount . "', '" . $FromID . "', '" . $ToID . "')";
	DB_query($SQL, __('The allocation could not be inserted because'), __('The SQL used was'), true);

	$Tolerance = CurrencyTolerance($CurrCode);
	foreach (array($ToID => $Amount, $FromID => -$Amount) as $ID => $Movement) {
		$Result = DB_query("SELECT ovamount + ovgst + ovfreight + ovdiscount AS total, alloc FROM debtortrans WHERE id='" . $ID . "'");
		$MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result);
		$NewAlloc = $MyRow['alloc'] + $Movement;
		$Settled = (abs($MyRow['total'] - $NewAlloc) < $Tolerance) ? 1 : 0;
		DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans SET alloc='" . $NewAlloc . "', settled='" . $Settled . "' WHERE id='" . $ID . "'",
				__('The allocation could not be updated because'), __('The SQL used was'), true);
	}
}

/* Accounts contact email addresses of a customer: the contacts flagged to receive statements */
function CreditAccountsEmails($DebtorNo) {
	$Emails = array();
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT email FROM custcontacts WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "' AND statement=1");
	while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result)) {
		if (IsEmailAddress($MyRow[0])) {
			$Emails[] = $MyRow[0];
		}
	}
	return $Emails;
}

/* The last reminder stage sent to a customer, 0 if none */
function CreditLastReminderStage($DebtorNo) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT stage FROM dunninglog WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "' ORDER BY sentdate DESC, dunningid DESC LIMIT 1");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	return $MyRow ? (int) $MyRow[0] : 0;
}

<?php

/* Shared credit control functions.
 *
 * Credit status is the existing customer "credit status" (debtorsmaster.holdreason -> holdreasons.dissallowinvoices):
 * 0 = normal, 1 = on stop (no invoicing, no orders), 2 = on watch (supplied, but warned).
 * Every change of status, limit and every other credit control action is written to creditlog.
 */

define('CREDIT_TOKEN_CONTROL', 21);
define('CREDIT_TOKEN_APPROVE', 22);

define('CREDIT_TYPE_CHARGE', 51);
define('CREDIT_TYPE_WAIVER', 52);
define('CREDIT_TYPE_WRITEOFF', 53);

function CreditStatusText($Dissallow) {
	switch ($Dissallow) {
		case 1:
			return __('On stop');
		case 2:
			return __('On watch');
		default:
			return __('Normal');
	}
}

/* Can the logged in user change credit status, limits, run reminders etc? */
function CreditUserCanControl() {
	return in_array(CREDIT_TOKEN_CONTROL, $_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens']);
}

/* Can the logged in user approve write-offs and change credit control settings? */
function CreditUserCanApprove() {
	return in_array(CREDIT_TOKEN_APPROVE, $_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens']);
}

/* SQL fragment restricting debtorsmaster rows to the customers of the logged in sales rep, if the user is a sales rep.
 * $DebtorField is the qualified debtorno column of the query. */
function CreditSalesmanFilter($DebtorField = 'debtorsmaster.debtorno') {
	if (isset($_SESSION['SalesmanLogin']) and $_SESSION['SalesmanLogin'] != '') {
		return " AND " . $DebtorField . " IN (SELECT debtorno FROM custbranch WHERE salesman='" . $_SESSION['SalesmanLogin'] . "') ";
	}
	return '';
}

/* Is the customer visible to the logged in user? A customer login sees only its own account, a sales rep only own customers. */
function CreditCanSeeCustomer($DebtorNo) {
	global $CustomerLogin;
	if (isset($CustomerLogin) and $CustomerLogin == 1 and $_SESSION['CustomerID'] != $DebtorNo) {
		return false;
	}
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT debtorno FROM debtorsmaster WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'" . CreditSalesmanFilter('debtorsmaster.debtorno'));
	return DB_num_rows($Result) == 1;
}

/* Returns the credit status row of a customer or false if the customer does not exist */
function GetCreditStatus($DebtorNo) {
	$SQL = "SELECT debtorsmaster.debtorno,
					debtorsmaster.name,
					debtorsmaster.currcode,
					debtorsmaster.creditlimit,
					debtorsmaster.holdreason,
					debtorsmaster.nextcreditreview,
					debtorsmaster.interestexempt,
					debtorsmaster.feeexempt,
					holdreasons.reasondescription,
					holdreasons.dissallowinvoices
			FROM debtorsmaster
			INNER JOIN holdreasons
				ON debtorsmaster.holdreason = holdreasons.reasoncode
			WHERE debtorsmaster.debtorno = '" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL);
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
		return false;
	}
	return DB_fetch_array($Result);
}

/* The first credit status code of a kind (1 stop, 2 watch, 0 normal), or false if none is defined */
function GetCreditReasonCode($Kind) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT reasoncode FROM holdreasons WHERE dissallowinvoices = '" . (int) $Kind . "' ORDER BY reasoncode");
	if ($MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result)) {
		return $MyRow[0];
	}
	return false;
}

/* Is the customer on stop? Used by every route that takes or releases an order */
function CreditCustomerOnStop($DebtorNo) {
	$Status = GetCreditStatus($DebtorNo);
	return ($Status !== false and $Status['dissallowinvoices'] == 1);
}

/* Audit trail. Rows are only ever inserted. */
function LogCreditEvent($DebtorNo, $EventType, $Detail, $Reason = '', $OldValue = '', $NewValue = '', $TransType = 0, $TransNo = 0) {
	$SQL = "INSERT INTO creditlog (debtorno,
									logdate,
									userid,
									eventtype,
									detail,
									reason,
									oldvalue,
									newvalue,
									transtype,
									transno
								) VALUES (
									'" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "',
									'" . date('Y-m-d H:i:s') . "',
									'" . (isset($_SESSION['UserID']) ? $_SESSION['UserID'] : 'system') . "',
									'" . $EventType . "',
									'" . DB_escape_string(mb_substr($Detail, 0, 250)) . "',
									'" . DB_escape_string($Reason) . "',
									'" . DB_escape_string($OldValue) . "',
									'" . DB_escape_string($NewValue) . "',
									'" . (int) $TransType . "',
									'" . (int) $TransNo . "'
								)";
	DB_query($SQL, __('The credit control history could not be updated because'));
}

/* Change the credit status of a customer to the given credit status code, and log it with the reason */
function SetCreditStatus($DebtorNo, $ReasonCode, $Reason) {
	$Current = GetCreditStatus($DebtorNo);
	if ($Current === false or $Current['holdreason'] == $ReasonCode) {
		return;
	}
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT reasondescription FROM holdreasons WHERE reasoncode='" . (int) $ReasonCode . "'");
	$NewRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	DB_query("UPDATE debtorsmaster SET holdreason='" . (int) $ReasonCode . "' WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'",
			__('The credit status of the customer could not be updated because'));
	LogCreditEvent($DebtorNo, 'STATUS', __('Credit status changed'), $Reason, $Current['reasondescription'], $NewRow[0]);
}

/* Change the credit limit and log it */
function SetCreditLimit($DebtorNo, $NewLimit, $Reason) {
	$Current = GetCreditStatus($DebtorNo);
	if ($Current === false or $Current['creditlimit'] == $NewLimit) {
		return;
	}
	DB_query("UPDATE debtorsmaster SET creditlimit='" . (float) $NewLimit . "' WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'",
			__('The credit limit of the customer could not be updated because'));
	LogCreditEvent($DebtorNo, 'LIMIT', __('Credit limit changed'), $Reason, $Current['creditlimit'], $NewLimit);
}

/* The date a standard review period from today, as Y-m-d */
function CreditDefaultNextReview() {
	$Months = isset($_SESSION['CreditReviewMonths']) ? (int) $_SESSION['CreditReviewMonths'] : 12;
	return date('Y-m-d', mktime(0, 0, 0, date('n') + $Months, date('j'), date('Y')));
}

/* SQL expression for the due date of a debtor transaction. $Trans and $Terms are the table aliases */
function CreditDueDateSQL($Trans = 'debtortrans', $Terms = 'paymentterms') {
	return "CASE WHEN " . $Terms . ".daysbeforedue > 0
				THEN DATE_ADD(" . $Trans . ".trandate, INTERVAL " . $Terms . ".daysbeforedue DAY)
				ELSE DATE_ADD(LAST_DAY(" . $Trans . ".trandate), INTERVAL " . $Terms . ".dayinfollowingmonth DAY)
			END";
}

/* Overdue debit items (invoices, charges and debtor journals still owing) of one customer, or of all customers when
 * $DebtorNo is empty. Disputed items are only returned when $IncludeDisputed is true. */
function CreditOverdueItems($DebtorNo = '', $MinDaysOverdue = 1, $IncludeDisputed = false) {
	$SQL = "SELECT debtortrans.id,
					debtortrans.debtorno,
					debtortrans.transno,
					debtortrans.type,
					debtortrans.trandate,
					debtortrans.balance,
					debtortrans.disputed,
					debtortrans.rate,
					debtortrans.reference,
					" . CreditDueDateSQL() . " AS duedate,
					TO_DAYS(NOW()) - TO_DAYS(" . CreditDueDateSQL() . ") AS daysoverdue
			FROM debtortrans
			INNER JOIN debtorsmaster
				ON debtortrans.debtorno = debtorsmaster.debtorno
			INNER JOIN paymentterms
				ON debtorsmaster.paymentterms = paymentterms.termsindicator
			WHERE debtortrans.type NOT IN (" . CREDIT_TYPE_WAIVER . ", " . CREDIT_TYPE_WRITEOFF . ", 11, 12)
				AND debtortrans.balance > 0.005
				AND debtortrans.settled = 0" .
				($IncludeDisputed ? '' : " AND debtortrans.disputed = 0") .
				($DebtorNo != '' ? " AND debtortrans.debtorno = '" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'" : '') . "
			HAVING daysoverdue >= " . (int) $MinDaysOverdue . "
			ORDER BY debtortrans.debtorno, debtortrans.trandate";
	return DB_query($SQL, __('The overdue transactions could not be retrieved because'));
}

/* Net balance of all of a customer's transactions, in the customer's currency */
function CreditCustomerBalance($DebtorNo) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT SUM(balance) FROM debtortrans WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	return (float) $MyRow[0];
}

/* Exchange rate (customer currency per home currency) of a currency */
function CreditCurrencyRate($CurrCode) {
	if ($CurrCode == $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['currencydefault']) {
		return 1;
	}
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT rate FROM currencies WHERE currabrev='" . $CurrCode . "'");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	if ($MyRow and $MyRow[0] > 0) {
		return $MyRow[0];
	}
	return 1;
}

/* Number of decimal places of the currency */
function CreditCurrencyDecimals($CurrCode) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT decimalplaces FROM currencies WHERE currabrev='" . $CurrCode . "'");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	return $MyRow ? (int) $MyRow[0] : 2;
}

/* The first branch of a customer: debtor transactions need a branch */
function CreditFirstBranch($DebtorNo) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT branchcode, salesman FROM custbranch WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "' ORDER BY branchcode LIMIT 1");
	return DB_fetch_array($Result);
}

/* Post a debtor transaction and its general ledger entries. Must be called inside a transaction that the caller
 * commits. $Amount is signed, in the customer's currency (positive debits the customer). The ledger is posted at
 * $Rate: debtors control gets Amount/Rate and $CounterAccount gets the opposite. Returns array(id, transno). */
function CreditPostDebtorTrans($DebtorNo, $Type, $Amount, $Rate, $CounterAccount, $Narrative, $Reference = '', $HomeAmountOverride = null) {
	$Branch = CreditFirstBranch($DebtorNo);
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT salestype FROM debtorsmaster WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	$SalesType = $MyRow[0];

	$TransNo = GetNextTransNo($Type);
	$PeriodNo = GetPeriod(date($_SESSION['DefaultDateFormat']));
	$TranDate = date('Y-m-d');

	$SQL = "INSERT INTO debtortrans (transno,
									type,
									debtorno,
									branchcode,
									trandate,
									inputdate,
									prd,
									reference,
									tpe,
									rate,
									ovamount,
									invtext,
									salesperson
								) VALUES (
									'" . $TransNo . "',
									'" . $Type . "',
									'" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "',
									'" . $Branch['branchcode'] . "',
									'" . $TranDate . "',
									'" . date('Y-m-d H:i:s') . "',
									'" . $PeriodNo . "',
									'" . DB_escape_string($Reference) . "',
									'" . $SalesType . "',
									'" . $Rate . "',
									'" . $Amount . "',
									'" . DB_escape_string($Narrative) . "',
									'" . $Branch['salesman'] . "'
								)";
	DB_query($SQL, __('The debtor transaction could not be inserted because'), __('The SQL used was'), true);
	$DebtorTransID = DB_Last_Insert_ID('debtortrans', 'id');

	if ($_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['gllink_debtors'] == 1) {
		$HomeAmount = ($HomeAmountOverride !== null) ? round($HomeAmountOverride, $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['decimalplaces']) : round($Amount / $Rate, $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['decimalplaces']);
		if ($HomeAmount != 0) {
			$SQL = "INSERT INTO gltrans (type, typeno, trandate, periodno, account, narrative, amount)
					VALUES ('" . $Type . "',
							'" . $TransNo . "',
							'" . $TranDate . "',
							'" . $PeriodNo . "',
							'" . $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['debtorsact'] . "',
							'" . DB_escape_string(mb_substr($DebtorNo . ' ' . $Narrative, 0, 200)) . "',
							'" . $HomeAmount . "')";
			DB_query($SQL, __('The debtors control posting could not be inserted because'), __('The SQL used was'), true);
			$SQL = "INSERT INTO gltrans (type, typeno, trandate, periodno, account, narrative, amount)
					VALUES ('" . $Type . "',
							'" . $TransNo . "',
							'" . $TranDate . "',
							'" . $PeriodNo . "',
							'" . $CounterAccount . "',
							'" . DB_escape_string(mb_substr($DebtorNo . ' ' . $Narrative, 0, 200)) . "',
							'" . -$HomeAmount . "')";
			DB_query($SQL, __('The ledger posting could not be inserted because'), __('The SQL used was'), true);
		}
		EnsureGLEntriesBalance($Type, $TransNo);
	}
	return array($DebtorTransID, $TransNo);
}

/* Allocate $Amount of the credit transaction $FromID (receipt, credit, write-off, waiver) to the debit item $ToID.
 * Same bookkeeping as CustomerAllocations.php: custallocns, alloc and settled on both transactions. Call inside a
 * transaction. */
function CreditAllocate($FromID, $ToID, $Amount, $CurrCode) {
	$SQL = "INSERT INTO custallocns (datealloc, amt, transid_allocfrom, transid_allocto)
			VALUES (CURRENT_DATE, '" . $Amount . "', '" . $FromID . "', '" . $ToID . "')";
	DB_query($SQL, __('The allocation could not be inserted because'), __('The SQL used was'), true);

	$Tolerance = CurrencyTolerance($CurrCode);
	foreach (array($ToID => $Amount, $FromID => -$Amount) as $ID => $Movement) {
		$Result = DB_query("SELECT ovamount + ovgst + ovfreight + ovdiscount AS total, alloc FROM debtortrans WHERE id='" . $ID . "'");
		$MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result);
		$NewAlloc = $MyRow['alloc'] + $Movement;
		$Settled = (abs($MyRow['total'] - $NewAlloc) < $Tolerance) ? 1 : 0;
		DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans SET alloc='" . $NewAlloc . "', settled='" . $Settled . "' WHERE id='" . $ID . "'",
				__('The allocation could not be updated because'), __('The SQL used was'), true);
	}
}

/* Accounts contact email addresses of a customer: the contacts flagged to receive statements */
function CreditAccountsEmails($DebtorNo) {
	$Emails = array();
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT email FROM custcontacts WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "' AND statement=1");
	while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result)) {
		if (IsEmailAddress($MyRow[0])) {
			$Emails[] = $MyRow[0];
		}
	}
	return $Emails;
}

/* The last reminder stage sent to a customer, 0 if none */
function CreditLastReminderStage($DebtorNo) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT stage FROM dunninglog WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "' ORDER BY sentdate DESC, dunningid DESC LIMIT 1");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	return $MyRow ? (int) $MyRow[0] : 0;
}

		$Month=$DateArray[0];
		$Year=$DateArray[2];
	} elseif ($DateFormat=='Y/m/d') {
		$Day=$DateArray[2];
		$Month=$DateArray[1];
		$Year=$DateArray[0];
	} elseif ($DateFormat=='d.m.Y') {
		$Day=$DateArray[0];
		$Month=$DateArray[1];
		$Year=$DateArray[2];
	}
	if (!checkdate(intval($Month), intval($Day), intval($Year))) {
		$Errors[$i] = InvalidItemDueDate;
	}
	return $Errors;
}

function GetCurrentPeriod () {

	$TransDate = time(); //The current date to find the period for
	/* Find the unix timestamp of the last period end date in periods table */
	$SQL = "SELECT MAX(lastdate_in_period), MAX(periodno) from periods";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL);
	$MyRow=DB_fetch_row($Result);

	if (is_null($MyRow[0])){
		$InsertFirstPeriodResult = api_DB_query("INSERT INTO periods VALUES (0,'" . Date('Y-m-d',mktime(0,0,0,Date('m')+1,0,Date('Y'))) . "')");
		$InsertFirstPeriodResult = api_DB_query("INSERT INTO periods VALUES (1,'" . Date('Y-m-d',mktime(0,0,0,Date('m')+2,0,Date('Y'))) . "')");
		$LastPeriod=1;
		$LastPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,Date('m')+2,0,Date('Y'));
	} else {
		$Date_Array = explode('-', $MyRow[0]);
		$LastPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,$Date_Array[1]+1,0,(int)$Date_Array[0]);
		$LastPeriod = $MyRow[1];
	}
	/* Find the unix timestamp of the first period end date in periods table */
	$SQL = "SELECT MIN(lastdate_in_period), MIN(periodno) from periods";
	$Result = api_DB_query($SQL);
	$MyRow=DB_fetch_row($Result);
	$Date_Array = explode('-', $MyRow[0]);
	$FirstPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,$Date_Array[1],0,(int)$Date_Array[0]);
	$FirstPeriod = $MyRow[1];

	/* If the period number doesn't exist */
	if (!PeriodExists($TransDate)) {
		/* if the transaction is after the last period */
		if ($TransDate > $LastPeriodEnd) {

			$PeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,Date('m', $TransDate)+1, 0, Date('Y', $TransDate));

			while ($PeriodEnd >= $LastPeriodEnd) {
				if (Date('m', $LastPeriodEnd)<=13) {
					$LastPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,Date('m', $LastPeriodEnd)+2, 0, Date('Y', $LastPeriodEnd));
				} else {
					$LastPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,2, 0, Date('Y', $LastPeriodEnd)+1);
				}
				$LastPeriod++;
				CreatePeriod($LastPeriod, $LastPeriodEnd);
			}
		} else {
		/* The transaction is before the first period */
			$PeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,Date('m', $TransDate), 0, Date('Y', $TransDate));
			$Period = $FirstPeriod - 1;
			while ($FirstPeriodEnd > $PeriodEnd) {
				CreatePeriod($Period, $FirstPeriodEnd);
				$Period--;
				if (Date('m', $FirstPeriodEnd)>0) {
					$FirstPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,Date('m', $FirstPeriodEnd), 0, Date('Y', $FirstPeriodEnd));
				} else {
					$FirstPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,13, 0, Date('Y', $FirstPeriodEnd));
				}
			}
		}
	} elseif (!PeriodExists(mktime(0,0,0,Date('m',$TransDate)+1,Date('d',$TransDate),Date('Y',$TransDate)))) {
		/* Make sure the following months period exists */
		$SQL = "SELECT MAX(lastdate_in_period), MAX(periodno) from periods";
		$Result = DB_query($SQL);
		$MyRow=DB_fetch_row($Result);
		$Date_Array = explode('-', $MyRow[0]);
		$LastPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,$Date_Array[1]+2,0,(int)$Date_Array[0]);
		$LastPeriod = $MyRow[1];
		CreatePeriod($LastPeriod+1, $LastPeriodEnd);
	}

	/* Now return the period number of the transaction */

<?php

/* Shared credit control functions.
 *
 * Credit status is the existing customer "credit status" (debtorsmaster.holdreason -> holdreasons.dissallowinvoices):
 * 0 = normal, 1 = on stop (no invoicing, no orders), 2 = on watch (supplied, but warned).
 * Every change of status, limit and every other credit control action is written to creditlog.
 */

define('CREDIT_TOKEN_CONTROL', 21);
define('CREDIT_TOKEN_APPROVE', 22);

define('CREDIT_TYPE_CHARGE', 51);
define('CREDIT_TYPE_WAIVER', 52);
define('CREDIT_TYPE_WRITEOFF', 53);

function CreditStatusText($Dissallow) {
	switch ($Dissallow) {
		case 1:
			return __('On stop');
		case 2:
			return __('On watch');
		default:
			return __('Normal');
	}
}

/* Can the logged in user change credit status, limits, run reminders etc? */
function CreditUserCanControl() {
	return in_array(CREDIT_TOKEN_CONTROL, $_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens']);
}

/* Can the logged in user approve write-offs and change credit control settings? */
function CreditUserCanApprove() {
	return in_array(CREDIT_TOKEN_APPROVE, $_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens']);
}

/* SQL fragment restricting debtorsmaster rows to the customers of the logged in sales rep, if the user is a sales rep.
 * $DebtorField is the qualified debtorno column of the query. */
function CreditSalesmanFilter($DebtorField = 'debtorsmaster.debtorno') {
	if (isset($_SESSION['SalesmanLogin']) and $_SESSION['SalesmanLogin'] != '') {
		return " AND " . $DebtorField . " IN (SELECT debtorno FROM custbranch WHERE salesman='" . $_SESSION['SalesmanLogin'] . "') ";
	}
	return '';
}

/* Is the customer visible to the logged in user? A customer login sees only its own account, a sales rep only own customers. */
function CreditCanSeeCustomer($DebtorNo) {
	global $CustomerLogin;
	if (isset($CustomerLogin) and $CustomerLogin == 1 and $_SESSION['CustomerID'] != $DebtorNo) {
		return false;
	}
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT debtorno FROM debtorsmaster WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'" . CreditSalesmanFilter('debtorsmaster.debtorno'));
	return DB_num_rows($Result) == 1;
}

/* Returns the credit status row of a customer or false if the customer does not exist */
function GetCreditStatus($DebtorNo) {
	$SQL = "SELECT debtorsmaster.debtorno,
					debtorsmaster.name,
					debtorsmaster.currcode,
					debtorsmaster.creditlimit,
					debtorsmaster.holdreason,
					debtorsmaster.nextcreditreview,
					debtorsmaster.interestexempt,
					debtorsmaster.feeexempt,
					holdreasons.reasondescription,
					holdreasons.dissallowinvoices
			FROM debtorsmaster
			INNER JOIN holdreasons
				ON debtorsmaster.holdreason = holdreasons.reasoncode
			WHERE debtorsmaster.debtorno = '" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL);
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
		return false;
	}
	return DB_fetch_array($Result);
}

/* The first credit status code of a kind (1 stop, 2 watch, 0 normal), or false if none is defined */
function GetCreditReasonCode($Kind) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT reasoncode FROM holdreasons WHERE dissallowinvoices = '" . (int) $Kind . "' ORDER BY reasoncode");
	if ($MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result)) {
		return $MyRow[0];
	}
	return false;
}

/* Is the customer on stop? Used by every route that takes or releases an order */
function CreditCustomerOnStop($DebtorNo) {
	$Status = GetCreditStatus($DebtorNo);
	return ($Status !== false and $Status['dissallowinvoices'] == 1);
}

/* Why an order cannot be dispatched or invoiced, or an empty string when it can. An order held for credit control is
 * blocked until released; an order of a customer on stop is blocked unless credit control has released it. */
function CreditOrderBlockReason($OrderNo) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT salesorders.creditheld, holdreasons.dissallowinvoices
						FROM salesorders
						INNER JOIN debtorsmaster ON salesorders.debtorno = debtorsmaster.debtorno
						INNER JOIN holdreasons ON debtorsmaster.holdreason = holdreasons.reasoncode
						WHERE salesorders.orderno = '" . (int) $OrderNo . "'");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	if ($MyRow === false or $MyRow['creditheld'] == 2) {
		return '';
	}
	if ($MyRow['creditheld'] == 1) {
		return __('This order is held for credit control approval because it takes the customer over their credit limit');
	}
	if ($MyRow['dissallowinvoices'] == 1) {
		return __('This customer is on stop. The order cannot be dispatched or invoiced until credit control releases it');
	}
	return '';
}

/* Audit trail. Rows are only ever inserted. */
function LogCreditEvent($DebtorNo, $EventType, $Detail, $Reason = '', $OldValue = '', $NewValue = '', $TransType = 0, $TransNo = 0) {
	$SQL = "INSERT INTO creditlog (debtorno,
									logdate,
									userid,
									eventtype,
									detail,
									reason,
									oldvalue,
									newvalue,
									transtype,
									transno
								) VALUES (
									'" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "',
									'" . date('Y-m-d H:i:s') . "',
									'" . (isset($_SESSION['UserID']) ? $_SESSION['UserID'] : 'system') . "',
									'" . $EventType . "',
									'" . DB_escape_string(mb_substr($Detail, 0, 250)) . "',
									'" . DB_escape_string($Reason) . "',
									'" . DB_escape_string($OldValue) . "',
									'" . DB_escape_string($NewValue) . "',
									'" . (int) $TransType . "',
									'" . (int) $TransNo . "'
								)";
	DB_query($SQL, __('The credit control history could not be updated because'));
}

/* Change the credit status of a customer to the given credit status code, and log it with the reason */
function SetCreditStatus($DebtorNo, $ReasonCode, $Reason) {
	$Current = GetCreditStatus($DebtorNo);
	if ($Current === false or $Current['holdreason'] == $ReasonCode) {
		return;
	}
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT reasondescription FROM holdreasons WHERE reasoncode='" . (int) $ReasonCode . "'");
	$NewRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	DB_query("UPDATE debtorsmaster SET holdreason='" . (int) $ReasonCode . "' WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'",
			__('The credit status of the customer could not be updated because'));
	LogCreditEvent($DebtorNo, 'STATUS', __('Credit status changed'), $Reason, $Current['reasondescription'], $NewRow[0]);
}

/* Change the credit limit and log it */
function SetCreditLimit($DebtorNo, $NewLimit, $Reason) {
	$Current = GetCreditStatus($DebtorNo);
	if ($Current === false or $Current['creditlimit'] == $NewLimit) {
		return;
	}
	DB_query("UPDATE debtorsmaster SET creditlimit='" . (float) $NewLimit . "' WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'",
			__('The credit limit of the customer could not be updated because'));
	LogCreditEvent($DebtorNo, 'LIMIT', __('Credit limit changed'), $Reason, $Current['creditlimit'], $NewLimit);
}

/* The date a standard review period from today, as Y-m-d */
function CreditDefaultNextReview() {
	$Months = isset($_SESSION['CreditReviewMonths']) ? (int) $_SESSION['CreditReviewMonths'] : 12;
	return date('Y-m-d', mktime(0, 0, 0, date('n') + $Months, date('j'), date('Y')));
}

/* SQL expression for the due date of a debtor transaction. $Trans and $Terms are the table aliases */
function CreditDueDateSQL($Trans = 'debtortrans', $Terms = 'paymentterms') {
	return "CASE WHEN " . $Terms . ".daysbeforedue > 0
				THEN DATE_ADD(" . $Trans . ".trandate, INTERVAL " . $Terms . ".daysbeforedue DAY)
				ELSE DATE_ADD(LAST_DAY(" . $Trans . ".trandate), INTERVAL " . $Terms . ".dayinfollowingmonth DAY)
			END";
}

/* Overdue debit items (invoices, charges and debtor journals still owing) of one customer, or of all customers when
 * $DebtorNo is empty. Disputed items are only returned when $IncludeDisputed is true. */
function CreditOverdueItems($DebtorNo = '', $MinDaysOverdue = 1, $IncludeDisputed = false) {
	$SQL = "SELECT debtortrans.id,
					debtortrans.debtorno,
					debtortrans.transno,
					debtortrans.type,
					debtortrans.trandate,
					debtortrans.balance,
					debtortrans.disputed,
					debtortrans.rate,
					debtortrans.reference,
					" . CreditDueDateSQL() . " AS duedate,
					TO_DAYS(NOW()) - TO_DAYS(" . CreditDueDateSQL() . ") AS daysoverdue
			FROM debtortrans
			INNER JOIN debtorsmaster
				ON debtortrans.debtorno = debtorsmaster.debtorno
			INNER JOIN paymentterms
				ON debtorsmaster.paymentterms = paymentterms.termsindicator
			WHERE debtortrans.type NOT IN (" . CREDIT_TYPE_WAIVER . ", " . CREDIT_TYPE_WRITEOFF . ", 11, 12)
				AND debtortrans.balance > 0.005
				AND debtortrans.settled = 0" .
				($IncludeDisputed ? '' : " AND debtortrans.disputed = 0") .
				($DebtorNo != '' ? " AND debtortrans.debtorno = '" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'" : '') . "
			HAVING daysoverdue >= " . (int) $MinDaysOverdue . "
			ORDER BY debtortrans.debtorno, debtortrans.trandate";
	return DB_query($SQL, __('The overdue transactions could not be retrieved because'));
}

/* Net balance of all of a customer's transactions, in the customer's currency */
function CreditCustomerBalance($DebtorNo) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT SUM(balance) FROM debtortrans WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	return (float) $MyRow[0];
}

/* Exchange rate (customer currency per home currency) of a currency */
function CreditCurrencyRate($CurrCode) {
	if ($CurrCode == $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['currencydefault']) {
		return 1;
	}
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT rate FROM currencies WHERE currabrev='" . $CurrCode . "'");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	if ($MyRow and $MyRow[0] > 0) {
		return $MyRow[0];
	}
	return 1;
}

/* Number of decimal places of the currency */
function CreditCurrencyDecimals($CurrCode) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT decimalplaces FROM currencies WHERE currabrev='" . $CurrCode . "'");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	return $MyRow ? (int) $MyRow[0] : 2;
}

/* The first branch of a customer: debtor transactions need a branch */
function CreditFirstBranch($DebtorNo) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT branchcode, salesman FROM custbranch WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "' ORDER BY branchcode LIMIT 1");
	return DB_fetch_array($Result);
}

/* Post a debtor transaction and its general ledger entries. Must be called inside a transaction that the caller
 * commits. $Amount is signed, in the customer's currency (positive debits the customer). The ledger is posted at
 * $Rate: debtors control gets Amount/Rate and $CounterAccount gets the opposite. Returns array(id, transno). */
function CreditPostDebtorTrans($DebtorNo, $Type, $Amount, $Rate, $CounterAccount, $Narrative, $Reference = '', $HomeAmountOverride = null) {
	$Branch = CreditFirstBranch($DebtorNo);
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT salestype FROM debtorsmaster WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	$SalesType = $MyRow[0];

	$TransNo = GetNextTransNo($Type);
	$PeriodNo = GetPeriod(date($_SESSION['DefaultDateFormat']));
	$TranDate = date('Y-m-d');

	$SQL = "INSERT INTO debtortrans (transno,
									type,
									debtorno,
									branchcode,
									trandate,
									inputdate,
									prd,
									reference,
									tpe,
									rate,
									ovamount,
									invtext,
									salesperson
								) VALUES (
									'" . $TransNo . "',
									'" . $Type . "',
									'" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "',
									'" . $Branch['branchcode'] . "',
									'" . $TranDate . "',
									'" . date('Y-m-d H:i:s') . "',
									'" . $PeriodNo . "',
									'" . DB_escape_string($Reference) . "',
									'" . $SalesType . "',
									'" . $Rate . "',
									'" . $Amount . "',
									'" . DB_escape_string($Narrative) . "',
									'" . $Branch['salesman'] . "'
								)";
	DB_query($SQL, __('The debtor transaction could not be inserted because'), __('The SQL used was'), true);
	$DebtorTransID = DB_Last_Insert_ID('debtortrans', 'id');

	if ($_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['gllink_debtors'] == 1) {
		$HomeAmount = ($HomeAmountOverride !== null) ? round($HomeAmountOverride, $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['decimalplaces']) : round($Amount / $Rate, $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['decimalplaces']);
		if ($HomeAmount != 0) {
			$SQL = "INSERT INTO gltrans (type, typeno, trandate, periodno, account, narrative, amount)
					VALUES ('" . $Type . "',
							'" . $TransNo . "',
							'" . $TranDate . "',
							'" . $PeriodNo . "',
							'" . $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['debtorsact'] . "',
							'" . DB_escape_string(mb_substr($DebtorNo . ' ' . $Narrative, 0, 200)) . "',
							'" . $HomeAmount . "')";
			DB_query($SQL, __('The debtors control posting could not be inserted because'), __('The SQL used was'), true);
			$SQL = "INSERT INTO gltrans (type, typeno, trandate, periodno, account, narrative, amount)
					VALUES ('" . $Type . "',
							'" . $TransNo . "',
							'" . $TranDate . "',
							'" . $PeriodNo . "',
							'" . $CounterAccount . "',
							'" . DB_escape_string(mb_substr($DebtorNo . ' ' . $Narrative, 0, 200)) . "',
							'" . -$HomeAmount . "')";
			DB_query($SQL, __('The ledger posting could not be inserted because'), __('The SQL used was'), true);
		}
		EnsureGLEntriesBalance($Type, $TransNo);
	}
	return array($DebtorTransID, $TransNo);
}

/* Allocate $Amount of the credit transaction $FromID (receipt, credit, write-off, waiver) to the debit item $ToID.
 * Same bookkeeping as CustomerAllocations.php: custallocns, alloc and settled on both transactions. Call inside a
 * transaction. */
function CreditAllocate($FromID, $ToID, $Amount, $CurrCode) {
	$SQL = "INSERT INTO custallocns (datealloc, amt, transid_allocfrom, transid_allocto)
			VALUES (CURRENT_DATE, '" . $Amount . "', '" . $FromID . "', '" . $ToID . "')";
	DB_query($SQL, __('The allocation could not be inserted because'), __('The SQL used was'), true);

	$Tolerance = CurrencyTolerance($CurrCode);
	foreach (array($ToID => $Amount, $FromID => -$Amount) as $ID => $Movement) {
		$Result = DB_query("SELECT ovamount + ovgst + ovfreight + ovdiscount AS total, alloc FROM debtortrans WHERE id='" . $ID . "'");
		$MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result);
		$NewAlloc = $MyRow['alloc'] + $Movement;
		$Settled = (abs($MyRow['total'] - $NewAlloc) < $Tolerance) ? 1 : 0;
		DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans SET alloc='" . $NewAlloc . "', settled='" . $Settled . "' WHERE id='" . $ID . "'",
				__('The allocation could not be updated because'), __('The SQL used was'), true);
	}
}

/* Accounts contact email addresses of a customer: the contacts flagged to receive statements */
function CreditAccountsEmails($DebtorNo) {
	$Emails = array();
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT email FROM custcontacts WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "' AND statement=1");
	while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result)) {
		if (IsEmailAddress($MyRow[0])) {
			$Emails[] = $MyRow[0];
		}
	}
	return $Emails;
}

/* The last reminder stage sent to a customer, 0 if none */
function CreditLastReminderStage($DebtorNo) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT stage FROM dunninglog WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "' ORDER BY sentdate DESC, dunningid DESC LIMIT 1");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	return $MyRow ? (int) $MyRow[0] : 0;
}

		$Errors=VerifyEDIInvoices($CustomerDetails['ediinvoices'], sizeof($Errors), $Errors);
	}
	if (isset($CustomerDetails['ediorders'])){
		$Errors=VerifyEDIOrders($CustomerDetails['ediorders'], sizeof($Errors), $Errors);
	}
	if (isset($CustomerDetails['edireference'])){
		$Errors=VerifyEDIReference($CustomerDetails['edireference'], sizeof($Errors), $Errors);
	}
	if (isset($CustomerDetails['editransport'])){
		$Errors=VerifyEDITransport($CustomerDetails['editransport'], sizeof($Errors), $Errors);
	}
	if (isset($CustomerDetails['ediserveruser'])){
		$Errors=VerifyEDIServerUser($CustomerDetails['ediserveruser'], sizeof($Errors), $Errors);
	}
	if (isset($CustomerDetails['ediserverpwd'])){
		$Errors=VerifyEDIServerPassword($CustomerDetails['ediserverpwd'], sizeof($Errors), $Errors);
	}
	if (isset($CustomerDetails['taxref'])){
		$Errors=VerifyTaxRef($CustomerDetails['taxref'], sizeof($Errors), $Errors);
	}
	if (isset($CustomerDetails['customerpoline'])){
		$Errors=VerifyCustomerPOLine($CustomerDetails['customerpoline'], sizeof($Errors), $Errors);
	}
	if (isset($CustomerDetails['typeid'])){
		$Errors=VerifyCustomerType($CustomerDetails['typeid'], sizeof($Errors), $Errors);
	}
	$SQL='UPDATE debtorsmaster SET ';
	foreach ($CustomerDetails as $key => $Value) {
		$SQL .= $key.'="'.$Value.'", ';
	}
	$SQL = mb_substr($SQL,0,-2)." WHERE debtorno='".$CustomerDetails['debtorno']."'";
	if (sizeof($Errors)==0) {
		$Result = DB_query($SQL);
		if (DB_error_no() != 0) {
			$Errors[0] = DatabaseUpdateFailed;
		} else {
			$Errors[0]=0;
		}
	}
	return $Errors;
}

/** This function takes a debtorno and returns an associative array containing
   the database record for that debtor. If the debtor number doesn't exist
   then it returns an $Errors array.
*/
function GetCustomer($DebtorNumber, $user, $password) {
	$Errors = array();
	$db = db($user, $password);
	if (gettype($db)=='integer') {
		$Errors[0]=NoAuthorisation;
		return $Errors;
	}
	$Errors = VerifyDebtorExists($DebtorNumber, sizeof($Errors), $Errors);
	if (sizeof($Errors)!=0) {
		return $Errors;
	}
	$SQL="SELECT * FROM debtorsmaster WHERE debtorno='".$DebtorNumber."'";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL);
	$Errors[0] = 0; // None found.
	$Errors[1] = DB_fetch_array($Result);

	return $Errors;
}

/** This function takes a field name, and a string, and then returns an
   array of debtornos that fulfill this criteria.
*/
function SearchCustomers($Field, $Criteria, $user, $password) {
	$Errors = array();
	$db = db($user, $password);
	if (gettype($db)=='integer') {
		$Errors[0]=NoAuthorisation;
		return $Errors;
	}
	$SQL='SELECT debtorno
		FROM debtorsmaster
		WHERE '.$Field." LIKE '%".$Criteria."%'";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL);
	$DebtorList = array(0);	    // First element: no errors
	while ($MyRow=DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		$DebtorList[]=$MyRow[0];
	}
	return $DebtorList;
}

<?php

/* Import debtors by csv file */

require(__DIR__ . '/includes/session.php');

$Title = __('Import Debtors And branches');
$ViewTopic = 'SpecialUtilities';
$BookMark = basename(__FILE__, '.php');
include('includes/header.php');

include('includes/SQL_CommonFunctions.php');

if (isset($_POST['FormID'])) {
	if (!isset($_POST['AutoDebtorNo'])) {
		$_POST['AutoDebtorNo'] = 0;
	} else {
		$_POST['AutoDebtorNo'] = 1;
	}
	if ($_POST['AutoDebtorNo'] == 1) {
		$_POST['UpdateIfExists'] = 0;
	} else {
		if (!isset($_POST['UpdateIfExists'])) {
			$_POST['UpdateIfExists'] = 0;
		} else {
			$_POST['UpdateIfExists'] = 1;
		}
	}
} else {
	$_POST['AutoDebtorNo'] = $_SESSION['AutoDebtorNo'];
	$_POST['UpdateIfExists'] = 0;
}

$FieldHeadings = array('debtorno', //0
'name', //1

	$FieldTarget = count($FieldHeadings);
	$InputError = 0;

	//check file info
	$FileName = $_FILES['userfile']['name'];
	$TempName = $_FILES['userfile']['tmp_name'];
	$FileSize = $_FILES['userfile']['size'];
	//get file handle
	$FileHandle = fopen($TempName, 'r');
	//get the header row
	$HeadRow = fgetcsv($FileHandle, 10000, ",");
	// Remove UTF-8 BOM if present
	if (substr($HeadRow[0], 0, 3) === "\xef\xbb\xbf") {
		$HeadRow[0] = substr($HeadRow[0], 3);
	}

	//check for correct number of fields
	if (count($HeadRow) != count($FieldHeadings)) {
		prnMsg(__('File contains ' . count($HeadRow) . ' columns, expected ' . count($FieldHeadings) . '. Try downloading a new template.'), 'error');
		fclose($FileHandle);
		include('includes/footer.php');
		exit();
	}

	$Head = 0;

		if (mb_strtoupper($HeadField) != mb_strtoupper($FieldHeadings[$Head])) {

<?php

/* Credit control: reviews, stop/watch audit, reminders, interest and fees, write-offs.
 * Everything here must also exist in install/sql/tables, install/sql/data/zz_credit_*.sql and the end of
 * install/sql/demo.sql, because the numbered updates never run on a fresh install.
 */

// Customer master: next review date and exemptions from interest and fees
AddColumn('nextcreditreview', 'debtorsmaster', 'date', 'NOT NULL', '1000-01-01', 'language_id');
AddColumn('interestexempt', 'debtorsmaster', 'tinyint', 'NOT NULL', '0', 'nextcreditreview');
AddColumn('feeexempt', 'debtorsmaster', 'tinyint', 'NOT NULL', '0', 'interestexempt');

// Invoices can be disputed - not chased and no interest
AddColumn('disputed', 'debtortrans', 'tinyint', 'NOT NULL', '0', 'salesperson');

// Orders held for credit control or released by credit control
AddColumn('creditheld', 'salesorders', 'tinyint', 'NOT NULL', '0', 'internalcomment');
AddColumn('creditreleasedby', 'salesorders', 'varchar(20)', 'NOT NULL', '', 'creditheld');

// GL accounts for the income and the bad debt
AddColumn('interestincomeact', 'companies', 'varchar(20)', 'NOT NULL', '0', 'freightact');
AddColumn('latefeeact', 'companies', 'varchar(20)', 'NOT NULL', '0', 'interestincomeact');
AddColumn('baddebtact', 'companies', 'varchar(20)', 'NOT NULL', '0', 'latefeeact');

CreateTable('creditreviews',
"CREATE TABLE `creditreviews` (
  `reviewid` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `debtorno` varchar(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `reviewdate` date NOT NULL DEFAULT '1000-01-01',
  `userid` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `outcome` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `oldlimit` double NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `newlimit` double NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `notes` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `nextreview` date NOT NULL DEFAULT '1000-01-01',
  PRIMARY KEY (`reviewid`),
  KEY `debtorno` (`debtorno`),
  KEY `reviewdate` (`reviewdate`),
  CONSTRAINT `creditreviews_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`debtorno`) REFERENCES `debtorsmaster` (`debtorno`)
)");

CreateTable('creditlog',
"CREATE TABLE `creditlog` (
  `logid` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `debtorno` varchar(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `logdate` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT '1000-01-01 00:00:00',
  `userid` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `eventtype` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `detail` varchar(250) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `reason` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `oldvalue` varchar(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `newvalue` varchar(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `transtype` smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `transno` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  PRIMARY KEY (`logid`),
  KEY `debtorno` (`debtorno`),
  KEY `logdate` (`logdate`),
  KEY `eventtype` (`eventtype`),
  CONSTRAINT `creditlog_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`debtorno`) REFERENCES `debtorsmaster` (`debtorno`)
)");

CreateTable('dunningstages',
"CREATE TABLE `dunningstages` (
  `stage` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `daysoverdue` smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `subject` varchar(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `body` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `autostop` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  PRIMARY KEY (`stage`)
)");

CreateTable('dunninglog',
"CREATE TABLE `dunninglog` (
  `dunningid` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `debtorno` varchar(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `stage` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `sentdate` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT '1000-01-01 00:00:00',
  `userid` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `method` varchar(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'email',
  `emailto` varchar(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `currcode` char(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `amount` double NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `invoices` text DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`dunningid`),
  KEY `debtorno` (`debtorno`),
  KEY `sentdate` (`sentdate`),
  CONSTRAINT `dunninglog_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`debtorno`) REFERENCES `debtorsmaster` (`debtorno`)
)");

CreateTable('creditcharges',
"CREATE TABLE `creditcharges` (
  `chargeid` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `debtorno` varchar(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `chargemonth` char(7) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `chargetype` char(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'I' COMMENT 'I interest, F late fee',
  `amount` double NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `debtortransid` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `waived` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `waivedtransid` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  PRIMARY KEY (`chargeid`),
  UNIQUE KEY `onechargepermonth` (`debtorno`,`chargemonth`,`chargetype`),
  KEY `debtortransid` (`debtortransid`),
  CONSTRAINT `creditcharges_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`debtorno`) REFERENCES `debtorsmaster` (`debtorno`)
)");

CreateTable('creditwriteoffs',
"CREATE TABLE `creditwriteoffs` (
  `writeoffid` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `debtorno` varchar(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `amount` double NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `currcode` char(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `reason` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `requestedby` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `requesteddate` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT '1000-01-01 00:00:00',
  `status` char(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'P' COMMENT 'P pending approval, A posted, R rejected',
  `approvedby` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `approveddate` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT '1000-01-01 00:00:00',
  `debtortransid` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `putonstop` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  PRIMARY KEY (`writeoffid`),
  KEY `debtorno` (`debtorno`),
  KEY `status` (`status`),
  CONSTRAINT `creditwriteoffs_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`debtorno`) REFERENCES `debtorsmaster` (`debtorno`)
)");

NewSysType(51, 'Interest and Late Fee Charge');

Credit Status Ratings

Each customer can be given a credit status that describes the risk as assessed by the credit controller, attached to invoices to the customer. This will never appear on any reports to customers. The customer selection screen allows customers to be restricted by their credit status so it is easy to perform inquiries on all the customers with a similar credit status. In addition the system will not allow invoices to customers whose credit status has a check in the field to prohibit invoicing. This is another credit control tool to the credit limit.

Credit Status Ratings can be amended and created from the main menu set up tab from the link labelled Credit Status Maintenance.

Status Code

This is any number from 1 to 100. A rating code is required to be held against every customer to identify the credit status of each. The code cannot be changed retrospectively.

Status Description

This field is used in look ups both in the customers amendment/entry and also in the customer selection screen. This is a text field up to 30 characters long.

Disallow Invoices

For all credit ratings set up, this field indicates whether or not the rating is serious enough to prohibit future invoicing to customers set up with this credit rating.

Credit Control

Credit control applies the same rules to every customer, whichever way the order arrives: entered by the sales office, placed by the customer in the web shop, sent electronically (EDI) or created from a standing order. Everything credit control decides - reviews, stop and watch, limit changes, reminders, charges, waivers and write-offs - is written to the customer's credit control history, with who did it, when and why. History rows cannot be changed or deleted.

Credit control uses two security tokens: Credit Control (token 21) for the credit controller and the deputy, and Credit Control approvals (token 22) for the Finance Director, who approves large write-offs and sets the credit control settings. Give the tokens to security roles in the Access Permissions Maintenance. Anyone without token 21 can see credit information but cannot change the credit status or the credit limit of a customer, in Customer Credit Control or in Customer maintenance. Sales reps (users set up for one sales person) only see their own customers.

Setting up

  1. In Credit Status Maintenance define at least one credit status that is On stop and one that is On watch, besides the normal status (the upgrade adds them when they are missing).
  2. In Company Preferences choose the GL accounts for interest income, late fee income and bad debts.
  3. In Credit Control Settings (system reports menu) set the standard review period, the annual interest rate, the late fee, the days overdue before charges apply, the write-off approval limit, and edit the reminder letter stages: how many days overdue triggers each stage and the wording of each letter. Letters are in one language only.
  4. In System Parameters, Check Credit Limits must be set to Warn or Prohibit for the credit limit checks. When it is set to Warn, orders that take a customer over the limit are held for credit control (this can be switched off in Credit Control Settings).
  5. At go-live every customer has a next review date. Use the utility Import Credit Status (csv: customer code, credit status code, credit limit, next review date) to put customers from the old stop list on stop and to load limits and review dates.

Credit reviews

Select the customer in Customer Credit Control. Record the review: the outcome (limit confirmed, raised, reduced, put on watch, put on stop), the new limit, notes and the next review date. The new limit and status apply at once, and the review is kept in the history. New customers get a next review date automatically, one standard review period after the account is opened. The credit control report lists customers whose review is due.

Stop and watch

A customer on stop cannot be given an order by any route, and goods cannot be dispatched or invoiced on orders already taken, unless credit control releases them in Orders Held for Credit Control. Standing orders for a customer on stop are not created (they are tried again at the next run, once the stop is lifted), and electronic orders are refused. A customer in the web shop is told the account is on hold and to contact us.

A customer on watch can be supplied, but anyone taking an order is warned, and the orders appear on the Orders Held for Credit Control list. Customers are never shown that they are on watch. The credit status is shown on the customer selection screen, the customer account and order entry.

Orders that take a customer over their credit limit are saved but held, and cannot be dispatched until credit control releases them.

To change the status of a customer use Change credit status with a reason. Taking a customer off stop needs a reason too. Tick invoices as disputed to leave them out of reminders and interest until the dispute is settled. Notes about debt collection or legal action handled outside the system can be added to the history.

Reminder letters

Run the Overdue Reminder Run (for example weekly). It lists each overdue customer with the stage of letter due: the highest stage whose days overdue has been reached. Tick Leave out for customers who must not be chased in this run, then email the reminders. A customer who has paid gets nothing, a customer is never sent the same stage twice within the minimum number of days, and disputed invoices are never chased. The letters go to the customer's contacts that are set to receive statements. Customers without an email address are listed so that the letter can be posted, and the run can then record the letters as posted. Each reminder is recorded with the date, stage, invoices and amount, and customers see them in their account.

Interest and late fees

At month end open Interest and Late Fees, choose the month and review the list of what will be charged to whom. Interest is one twelfth of the annual rate on invoices overdue by more than the charge days (interest is never charged on earlier interest and fees); the late fee is a fixed fee per customer per month, converted to the customer's currency. Customers exempt from interest or fees are marked in Customer Credit Control. Confirm to post the charges as separate items on the customer account (they show on the next statement) and to the general ledger. The same month cannot be charged twice for a customer. A charge can be waived with a reason; the waiver is posted to the ledger too.

Bad debt write-offs

Request a write-off of all or part of a customer's open invoices with a reason. Write-offs up to the approval limit are posted at once; larger ones wait until the Finance Director approves them on the same screen. A write-off reduces the customer's balance, is allocated to the oldest open invoices, and posts to the bad debt account; the customer is put on stop unless the option is cleared. The report at the bottom of the screen lists write-offs over a period with who requested and approved them.

Credit control report

Lists customers due or overdue for a credit review, customers over their credit limit, and customers on watch or on stop, filtered by sales person and currency, with totals in the home currency. The aged debtors report also shows each customer's credit status, credit limit and the last reminder stage sent.

Month end reconciliation

The Debtors Control Reconciliation compares the debtors control account in the general ledger with the customer transactions and balances, and lists the transactions and journals that explain a difference.

Notes for sales staff

On watch: you may take orders; you will see a warning. Talk to the customer before they order and contact credit control. On stop: you cannot take or release orders for the customer and you cannot lift the stop or raise the limit yourself. Orders held for credit control wait until credit control releases them. Contact the credit controller.

1	# Changelog
2	
3	All changes details to the webERP project between v4.14.1 and the latest v4 version are documented in this file.
4	The format is based on [Keep a Changelog], and this project adheres to [Semantic Versioning].
5	
6	For changelogs of v5 and later, please look at the git commit logs for the `master` branch, available at
7	https://github.com/timschofield/webERP/commits/master/
8	For changelogs earlier than v4.14.1, please refer to [CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md].
9	
10	For a high-level overview of the main changes, starting with v5, look at [NEWS.md]
11	
12	## Guidelines
13	- Keep descriptions as short and concise as possible.
14	- If including html tags in your description, please surround them with back ticks.
15	- The commit Type, will typically be one of the following: `Added`, `Changed`, `Deprecated`, `Removed`, `Fixed`, `Security`
16	- Enter dates in format yyyy-mm-dd.
17	- Add links to the associated GitHub commit in Details column.
18	- Add links to supporting info in Ref column, such as Forum posts, Mailing List archives or GitHub issues.

# Changelog

All changes details to the webERP project between v4.14.1 and the latest v4 version are documented in this file.
The format is based on [Keep a Changelog], and this project adheres to [Semantic Versioning].

For changelogs of v5 and later, please look at the git commit logs for the `master` branch, available at
https://github.com/timschofield/webERP/commits/master/
For changelogs earlier than v4.14.1, please refer to [CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md].

For a high-level overview of the main changes, starting with v5, look at [NEWS.md]

## Guidelines
- Keep descriptions as short and concise as possible.
- If including html tags in your description, please surround them with back ticks.
- The commit Type, will typically be one of the following: `Added`, `Changed`, `Deprecated`, `Removed`, `Fixed`, `Security`
- Enter dates in format yyyy-mm-dd.
- Add links to the associated GitHub commit in Details column.
- Add links to supporting info in Ref column, such as Forum posts, Mailing List archives or GitHub issues.
